literature.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 研究指出麻疹在美国持续传播,特别提到不同地区出现的暴发,并且病例数量较往年有所增加。 [10.1097/ajn.0000000000000388e]
多模态影像学显示黄斑全层视网膜炎,具有典型的" moth-eaten "(蛾食状)外观,并伴有光学相干断层扫描(OCT)上完整内层视网膜限制膜(ILM)的" ballooning "(气球样膨出)。 [10.1080/09273948.2026.2735408]
我们发现第一剂疫苗后ITP的风险增加(相对风险2.38(95% CI:2.12-2.67)),每42,900剂疫苗中可归因的风险为1例。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129168]
麻疹病毒RNA在废水样本的固体中最为集中,等质量基础上检测到95.95%的信号。麻疹病毒废水信号与临床病例呈强正相关,标准化信号的斯皮尔曼相关系数为0.77(95% CI 0.51–0.87),原始信号的斯皮尔曼相关系数为0.77(95% CI 0.49–0.90)。还观察到麻疹病毒信号与由化粪池运输公司排放的总粪便体积之间的相关性。 [10.3201/eid3210.260092]
后者假设需要增加投资以覆盖难以到达的人群。 [10.1371/journal.pgph.0006440]

We found an increased risk of ITP after dose 1 (relative incidence 2.38 (95% CI: 2.12-2.67)) with an attributable risk of 1 in 42,900 doses. [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129168]
MeV RNA was found to be most concentrated in the solids of wastewater samples, with 95.95% of the signal detected on an equivalent-mass basis. [10.3201/eid3210.260092]
The later assumed increased investments to reach hard-to-reach populations. [10.1371/journal.pgph.0006440]

news.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 斯库尔基尔县学校正在为学生可能出现的麻疹病例做准备,这是该州确认该县近二十年来首例病例后采取的措施。该事件由州卫生部门确认。 [news-9505871f5e39a199]
文章报道了麻疹病毒 突变能够使其在中枢神经系统中持续存在,从而导致亚急性硬化性全脑炎(SSPE),一种致命的神经退行性疾病。这是基于研究和临床观察的确认科学发现。 [news-bdf167c98e00c832]
宾夕法尼亚州卫生部门确认了835例麻疹病例,并与麻疹病毒相关的4例死亡。这些死亡病例被归因于麻疹,包括兰开斯特县的两例婴儿病例、杰斐逊县的一位40岁女性病例以及米夫林县的一位18岁男性病例。 [news-6036c301417a1ea2]
麻疹病例数量超过2025年水平的两倍,南卡罗来纳州和宾夕法尼亚州推动了病例激增。该报告来自globalbiodefense.com。 [news-77da01dde0e93193]
宾夕法尼亚州包括索默塞特县在内的地区正在发生麻疹病例扩散,有4例死亡与麻疹相关并发症有关。截至2026年9月18日,宾夕法尼亚州卫生部报告了超过760例病例,索默塞特县有13例病例。 [news-748b7eae0244c5a6]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Measles virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Schuylkill County schools are preparing for possible measles cases in students, following the state’s confirmation of the first case in the county in over two decades. The event is confirmed by the state Department of Health. [news-9505871f5e39a199]

The article reports on measles virus mutations that allow it to persist in the central nervous system, leading to subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a fatal neurodegenerative disorder. This is a confirmed scientific finding based on research and clinical observations. [news-bdf167c98e00c832]

The Pennsylvania Department of Health confirmed 835 measles cases and four deaths associated with the measles virus. The deaths were attributed to measles, with two infants in Lancaster County, a 40-year-old woman in Jefferson County, and an 18-year-old man in Mifflin County. [news-6036c301417a1ea2]
Measles cases more than doubled compared to 2025 levels, with South Carolina and Pennsylvania driving the surge. The report is from globalbiodefense.com. [news-77da01dde0e93193]

Measles cases are spreading in Pennsylvania, including Somerset County, with four confirmed deaths due to measles-associated complications. The Pennsylvania Department of Health reported over 760 cases in 2026, and Somerset County had 13 cases as of September 18, 2026. [news-748b7eae0244c5a6]

papers.title: Cost-effectiveness and budget impact analyses of strategies to improve measles vaccination coverage in Kenya.
papers.abstract: Measles control efforts have been implemented over the years. However, elimination of the disease is yet to be realized. Additionally, global measles vaccination coverage has stagnated over the past decade, leading to outbreaks. We assessed the cost-effectiveness and budget impact of scaling-up vaccination coverage in Kenya, towards the measles elimination goal. A cost-effectiveness analysis was conducted using a Markov model from a health system's perspective over a 10-year time frame, incorporating a new birth cohort annually. Two vaccination scenarios were examined 1) a constant coverage improvement scenario, assuming current funding is maintained resulting in annual increases of 0.3% and 2% in the first and second-dose measles vaccine coverage, respectively, alongside supplementary immunization activities(SIAs) and 2) an intensified investment scenario, assuming achievement of 95% coverage for both vaccine doses in addition to SIAs. The later assumed increased investments to reach hard-to-reach populations. A threshold of USD 1,280 per disability adjusted life year (DALY) averted was applied. A budget impact analysis was also conducted. Over a 10-year time horizon, the constant coverage improvement scenario led to 6% fewer deaths (213 (161-276)) and was cost-effective (incremental cost-effectiveness ratio, ICER = USD 1,269 ($1,205-$1,333) per DALY averted) compared to the base scenario. Increasing coverage in the intensified investment scenario, further reduced deaths by 25% (879(626--1,284)) and was more cost effective, ICER 1,093 (1,029 -1,157) per DALY averted, compared to the constant improvement scenario. The constant improvement scenario had a moderate budget impact while the intensified improvement scenario had a very high budget impact, when assessed against Kenya's health expenditure. Our findings suggest that accelerating measles coverage through intensified investments towards measles elimination is cost-effective but has a high budget impact. Therefore, policy makers should consider market shaping interventions and strategies to mobilize and allocate sufficient resources to increase vaccination coverage and ensure sustained health gains.

Therefore, policy makers should consider market shaping interventions and strategies to mobilize and allocate sufficient resources to increase vaccination coverage and ensure sustained health gains.

papers.title: The risk of idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura after first and second measles, mumps, rubella (MMR) vaccine doses in children born in England 2000-2019.
papers.abstract: We assessed the risk of Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) after Measles Mumps Rubella vaccine (MMR) doses 1 and 2 in children in England born from 2000 to 2019. After linking hospitalised ITP episodes to MMR vaccine records, we used the self-control case-series method to assess the relative incidence in the 6-week period post vaccination. We also assessed the risk of ITP after dose 2 in those who had ITP after dose 1. We found an increased risk of ITP after dose 1 (relative incidence 2.38 (95% CI: 2.12-2.67)) with an attributable risk of 1 in 42,900 doses. We found no evidence of an increased risk after dose 2 (relative incidence 0.96 (95% CI: 0.81-1.13)). Furthermore, we found that the 336 children with ITP after dose 1 who had MMR dose 2 had no increased risk in the 6-weeks after this dose and that it is therefore safe to vaccinate these children.

papers.source_body_en: We assessed the risk of Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) after Measles Mumps Rubella vaccine (MMR) doses 1 and 2 in children in England born from 2000 to 2019. After linking hospitalised ITP episodes to MMR vaccine records, we used the self-control case-series method to assess the relative incidence in the 6-week period post vaccination. We also assessed the risk of ITP after dose 2 in those who had ITP after dose 1. We found an increased risk of ITP after dose 1 (relative incidence 2.38 (95% CI: 2.12-2.67)) with an attributable risk of 1 in 42,900 doses. We found no evidence of an increased risk after dose 2 (relative incidence 0.96 (95% CI: 0.81-1.13)). Furthermore, we found that the 336 children with ITP after dose 1 who had MMR dose 2 had no increased risk in the 6-weeks after this dose and that it is therefore safe to vaccinate these children.

papers.title: SUBACUTE SCLEROSING PANENCEPHALITIS: CLINICAL REVIEW OF PATHOGENESIS, DIAGNOSIS AND MANAGEMENT
papers.abstract: Introduction: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a rare, chronic, progressive and fatal neurodegenerative disorder caused by persistent infection with mutant Measles virus. It develops years after primary measles infection and predominantly affects children and adolescents, leading to severe neurological deterioration. Aim: The aim of this paper is to review the etiology, pathogenesis, clinical representation, diagnostic criteria, treatment options and prevention strategies related to SSPE. Methodology: This paper is based on a literature review using medical textbooks and scientific articles addressing the epidemiology, diagnosis and management of SSPE. Results: SSPE commonly presents with behavioral and cognitive decline, myoclonic jerks, motor dysfunction, seizures and progressive loss of neurological function. Diagnosis is established through characteristic clinical findings, electroencephalography changes, neuroimaging and elevated measles antibody in cerebrospinal fluid. Current treatment options including antiviral and immunomodulatory therapies, may slow disease progression in some patients, but prognosis remains poor in most cases. Conclusion: SSPE remains a devastating late complication of measles infection with limited therapeutic success. Early recognition is important for supportive management, while prevention through effective measles vaccination remains the most important strategy for reducing the incidence, morbidity and mortality associated with this disease.

papers.abstract_zh: 引言:亚急性硬化性全脑炎(SSPE)是由突变麻疹病毒引起的罕见、慢性、进行性和致命性神经退行性疾病。它通常在初次麻疹感染数年后发生,主要影响儿童和青少年,导致严重的神经功能恶化。目的:本文旨在回顾与SSPE相关的病因、诊断、临床表现、诊断标准、治疗选择和预防策略。方法:本文基于使用医学教科书和科学文章进行的文献回顾,涵盖SSPE的诊断、管理及治疗。结果:SSPE常见表现为行为和认知功能下降、肌阵挛性抽搐、运动功能障碍、癫痫发作以及进行性神经功能丧失。诊断通过特征性临床表现、脑电图变化、神经影像学检查以及脑脊液中麻疹病毒抗体升高来确立。目前的治疗选择包括抗病毒药物和免疫调节治疗,可能在某些患者中减缓疾病进展,但大多数情况下预后仍较差。结论:SSPE仍然是麻疹病毒感染的一种毁灭性的晚期并发症,治疗效果有限。早期识别对于支持性管理至关重要,而通过有效的疫苗接种进行预防则是减少该病相关发病率、患病率和死亡率的最重要策略。

papers.title: Measles-Related Macular Necrotizing Retinitis in an Unvaccinated Adult: A Case Report
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: To describe the clinical features, multimodal imaging (MMI) findings, and therapeutic management in a case of asynchronous bilateral macular necrotizing measles-related retinitis in an unvaccinated adult. METHODS: Observational case report. RESULTS: A 36-year-old unvaccinated male presented with acute vision loss in the right eye. He had a past history of idiopathic encephalitis and prior necrotizing retinitis in the contralateral eye. MMI revealed full-thickness macular retinitis with the characteristic "moth-eaten" appearance accompanied by the "ballooning" of an intact internal limiting membrane (ILM) on optical coherence tomography (OCT). Both intraocular fluid and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) PCR, and the CSF/serum measles-specific antibody index, were non-diagnostic contributory, a known limitation in late-onset, compartmentalized measles complications. Diagnosis was reached through integration of clinical history, systemic seropositivity, and hallmark MMI features. A combined treatment regimen of remdesivir, pegylated interferon alpha-2a, and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) appeared to halt disease progression and preserved central vision. CONCLUSION: Late-onset measles retinitis poses a significant diagnostic challenge, as negative direct molecular testing may mislead clinicians and delay appropriate treatment. This case underscores the critical role of systemic serology, MMI, and structured clinical reasoning in reaching a timely diagnosis. In an era of declining vaccination coverage, clinicians should maintain a high index of suspicion for measles-related ocular complications.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a rare and severe ocular complication of measles in an unvaccinated adult, highlighting the challenges in diagnosing late-onset measles retinitis. The patient presented with acute vision loss and a history of prior retinitis in the contralateral eye. Multimodal imaging revealed characteristic features of macular necrotizing retinitis, while PCR and serological tests were non-diagnostic. The authors emphasize the importance of integrating clinical history, serology, and imaging for accurate diagnosis. The case underscores the need for heightened clinical suspicion in measles-related ocular complications, especially in areas with declining vaccination rates. However, the study's reliance on a single case limits the strength of its conclusions, and the evidence is considered moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述一例未接种疫苗成人异步双侧黄斑坏死性麻疹相关视网膜炎的临床特征、多模态影像学表现及治疗管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项观察性病例报告涉及一名36岁未接种疫苗男性,他因右眼急性视力下降就诊,并且有特发性脑炎病史以及左眼曾发生过坏死性视网膜炎的既往史。
elements_zh.methods: 通过整合临床病史、系统性血清阳性反应以及标志性多模态影像学特征,最终确诊为诊断。眼内液和脑脊液(CSF)的PCR检测以及CSF/血清麻疹特异性抗体指数均为非诊断性,这是已知的晚期发病、分隔性麻疹并发症的局限性。
elements_zh.main_results: 多模态影像学显示黄斑全层视网膜炎,具有典型的" moth-eaten "(蛾食状)外观,并伴有光学相干断层扫描(OCT)上完整内层视网膜限制膜(ILM)的" ballooning "(气球样膨出)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,晚期发病的麻疹视网膜炎具有显著的诊断挑战,因为直接分子检测结果为阴性可能会误导临床医生并延迟适当的治疗治疗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本病例强调了系统性血清学、多模态影像学以及结构化临床推理在及时诊断麻疹相关眼部并发症中的关键作用,特别是在疫苗接种覆盖率下降的背景下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于PCR和血清学检测在晚期发病的麻疹并发症中具有非诊断性,因此该研究存在局限性,这可能会影响诊断的可靠性。由于依赖于单一病例报告,证据强度被评定为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:描述一例未接种疫苗成人异步双侧黄斑坏死性麻疹相关视网膜炎的临床特征、多模态影像学(MMI)表现及治疗管理。方法:观察性病例报告。结果:一名36岁未接种疫苗男性因右眼急性视力下降就诊。他有特发性脑炎病史,并且左眼曾发生过坏死性视网膜炎。多模态影像学显示黄斑全层视网膜炎,具有典型的" moth-eaten "(蛾食状)外观,并伴有光学相干断层扫描(OCT)上完整内层视网膜限制膜(ILM)的" ballooning "(气球样膨出)。眼内液和脑脊液(CSF)的PCR检测以及CSF/血清麻疹特异性抗体指数均为非诊断性,这是已知的晚期发病、分隔性麻疹并发症的局限性。通过整合临床病史、系统性血清阳性反应以及标志性多模态影像学特征,最终确诊为诊断。采用联合治疗治疗方案,包括瑞德西韦、聚乙二醇干扰素α-2a和静脉注射免疫球蛋白(IVIg),似乎能够阻止疾病进展并保留中心视力。结论:晚期发病的麻疹视网膜炎具有显著的诊断挑战,因为直接分子检测结果为阴性可能会误导临床医生并延迟适当的治疗治疗。本病例强调了系统性血清学、多模态影像学以及结构化临床推理在及时诊断麻疹相关眼部并发症中的关键作用,特别是在疫苗接种覆盖率下降的背景下。

papers.title: Timeliness of measles vaccination in selected districts of Oromia Region, Ethiopia – 2021
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Delays in vaccination with the first/second dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1, MCV2) increases risk of measles transmission. MCV2 was added to Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule in 2019, administered at age 15 months. We describe age at measles vaccination and characteristics associated with timely vaccination following MCV2 introduction. METHODS: A secondary analysis from a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12-35 months in Oromia, Ethiopia was conducted. MCV vaccination status and age at vaccination were determined from the child's vaccination card. The cumulative card-confirmed vaccination coverage of MCV1 and MCV2 (among children 24-35 months) by age at vaccination was estimated. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression, with urban/rural stratification. RESULTS: Overall, 651 children aged 12-35 months (MCV1) and a subset of 270 children aged 24-35 months (MCV2) were analyzed. Cumulative MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, and MCV2 was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was generally higher in urban compared to rural areas. Among vaccinated children, the proportion receiving early, timely, and delayed doses was 30.1%, 44.5%, and 25.3% for MCV1, and 28.6%, 41.2%, and 30.3% for MCV2, respectively. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. CONCLUSIONS: Although most children who received MCV1 were vaccinated by 12 months, many received delayed doses. MCV2 coverage was low, irrespective of vaccination timing. Findings highlight the importance of routine catch-up vaccination policies and guidance, and the need for tailored strategies in urban and rural settings to improve MCV coverage and timely vaccination.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:在接种含疫苗(MCV1、MCV2)的麻疹疫苗的第一/第二剂时出现延迟会增加传播的风险。MCV2于2019年被纳入埃塞俄比亚的常规免疫计划,接种年龄为15个月。我们描述了在MCV2引入后,儿童接种疫苗接种的年龄及其与及时接种相关的特征。方法:对埃塞俄比亚奥罗米亚州2021年一项针对12-35个月儿童的横断面家庭调查进行了二次分析。MCV 疫苗接种接种状态和接种年龄是从儿童的疫苗接种卡中确定的。估计了24-35个月儿童中MCV1和MCV2的累计卡确认接种覆盖率,按接种年龄进行分析。使用多变量逻辑回归分析了与及时MCV1接种相关的特征,并按城乡进行分层。结果:总体分析了651名12-35个月的儿童(MCV1)和其中270名24-35个月的儿童(MCV2)。MCV1的累计接种覆盖率为9个月时59.9%,12个月时76.3%;MCV2的累计接种覆盖率为15个月时33.0%,24个月时44.8%。MCV接种覆盖率在城市地区普遍高于农村地区。在接种过疫苗的儿童中,早期、及时和延迟接种的比例分别为MCV1的30.1%、44.5%和25.3%,以及MCV2的28.6%、41.2%和30.3%。与及时MCV1接种相关的特征在城乡地区有所不同,但共同主题包括增加的照顾者疫苗接种意识和服务提供方面。结论:尽管大多数接种MCV1的儿童在12个月内完成了接种,但许多儿童接种时间有所延迟。无论接种时间如何,MCV2的接种覆盖率都较低。这些发现强调了常规补种政策和指导的重要性,并突出了在城乡地区制定针对性策略以提高MCV接种覆盖率和及时接种的必要性。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to examine the lessons learned from the West Texas measles outbreak regarding public health leadership and response strategies. The background highlighted the resurgence of measles and the importance of effective public health management in controlling outbreaks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a commentary on the West Texas measles outbreak, analyzing the public health leadership and response during the event. It describes the outbreak's occurrence in a specific geographic location and its impact on the local population.
analysis.methods: The methods involved a retrospective analysis of the outbreak's management, including the evaluation of public health interventions, communication strategies, and the role of leadership in mitigating the spread of measles.
analysis.main_results: The study reported that the outbreak was effectively managed through coordinated public health efforts, including vaccination campaigns and community engagement, which helped to contain the spread of measles.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the outbreak as a case study demonstrating the critical role of leadership in public health crises. The novelty lies in the emphasis on leadership and community collaboration as key factors in outbreak control.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health practices by highlighting the importance of leadership and community engagement in managing measles outbreaks and preventing their spread.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a commentary and does not include quantitative data or statistical analysis, which limits the strength of the evidence. However, the insights are grounded in real-world public health experience.

analysis.summary_en: This commentary reflects on the West Texas measles outbreak, emphasizing the importance of public health leadership and community engagement in outbreak management. The study outlines the outbreak's context, the interventions implemented, and the lessons learned. It highlights the role of coordinated efforts in containing measles transmission and suggests that these strategies can inform future public health responses. The analysis is based on a narrative review of the event, which provides valuable insights but lacks quantitative data, thus limiting the strength of the evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨西得克萨斯州麻疹 暴发事件中所学到的公共卫生领导力和应对策略。背景强调了麻疹的再次暴发,以及有效公共卫生管理在控制暴发中的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对西得克萨斯州麻疹 暴发事件的评论,分析了该事件期间的公共卫生领导力和应对措施。它描述了暴发在特定地理区域的发生及其对当地人口的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 研究方法包括对暴发管理的回顾性分析,涉及对公共卫生干预措施、沟通策略以及领导力在遏制麻疹传播中的作用的评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究指出,通过协调的公共卫生努力,包括疫苗接种宣传活动和社区参与,有效控制了暴发的传播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将暴发视为一个案例研究,展示了领导力在公共卫生危机中的关键作用。其新颖之处在于强调领导力和社区合作是控制暴发的关键因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过突出领导力和社区参与在管理麻疹 暴发及防止其传播中的重要性,为公共卫生实践提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于评论,未包含定量数据或统计分析,这限制了证据的强度。然而,这些见解建立在真实世界公共卫生经验的基础上。

papers.title: Threat Amplified, Blame Restrained: LLM-Assisted Media Framing Analysis of the 2026 Bangladesh Measles Outbreak
papers.abstract: How news media frame and emotionally code a public health emergency shapes public risk perception and trust, yet outbreak-coverage dynamics remain understudied for low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We examine sentiment and stance in English-language Bangladeshi coverage of the 2026 measles outbreak -- the country's most severe in two decades, with over 97,000 suspected cases and 600 deaths across 61 of 64 districts, unfolding after the 2024 change of government and a 2024-2025 vaccine stockout. Using the Internet Archive, we build a reproducible corpus of 403 headlines from seven national outlets (396 in-window in 2026), label them for binary sentiment and four-way stance via a large language model under a locked codebook, and validate against a two-coder human-adjudicated gold standard (n=153; Cohen's kappa=0.89 stance, 0.75 sentiment). Aligned to the DGHS epidemic curve, coverage grew significantly more negative (56% to 88% negative; Cochran-Armitage z=4.12, p<.001) and risk-amplification framing intensified (44% to 84%; z=4.15, p<.001). Media negativity lagged incidence, tracking cumulative mortality. Contrary to the political backdrop, blame remained a minority frame (~9% overall) and was overwhelmingly systemic (32 of 37, 86%) rather than directed at named actors. The pipeline offers a scalable, transparent method for LMIC outbreak-media analysis; Bangladeshi coverage amplified threat far more than it assigned political blame.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how news media framed the 2026 measles outbreak in Bangladesh, focusing on sentiment and stance in English-language coverage. The outbreak, the most severe in two decades, involved over 97,000 suspected cases and 600 deaths across 61 districts. The research used a corpus of 403 headlines from seven national outlets, labeled by a large language model and validated by human coders. Results showed a significant increase in negative coverage and risk-amplification framing over time, with media negativity lagging behind incidence but aligning with cumulative mortality. The study highlights the importance of media framing in shaping public perception during public health emergencies, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. The analysis provides a scalable method for media evaluation in such contexts, emphasizing the amplification of threat over political blame. The findings suggest that media coverage can influence public trust and risk perception, but the study does not report specific limitations or evidence strength assessment.

papers.title: Seroprotection after measles vaccination in children with sickle cell anemia receiving hydroxyurea.
papers.abstract: Children with sickle cell anemia (SCA) may have decreased antibody responses after some routine vaccines, but it is not known whether this affects the response to measles vaccination. It is critical to determine whether children with SCA develop adequate seroprotection after measles vaccination considering the rise in measles infections in the United States and persistent transmission globally, particularly in regions with high SCA prevalence. It is also unknown whether concurrent hydroxyurea treatment affects the measles antibody response to vaccination. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of children with SCA enrolled in the TREAT trial to determine antimeasles seroprotection (immunoglobulin G of ≥200 IU/L via enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay) after first and second measles vaccine (MV1 and MV2, respectively). Seroprotection was reached by 33 of 35 children (94%) after MV1 and by 46 of 50 (92%) after MV2. Each additional year of age at MV2 was associated with decreased odds of seroprotection (odds ratio [OR], 0.25; P = .02). Hydroxyurea treatment at the time of vaccination did not reduce seroprotection; rather, earlier hydroxyurea initiation was associated with increased seroprotection (OR, 4.4; P = .02). Most children with SCA are adequately protected after measles vaccination, similar to the general population, and seroprotection is increased with timely vaccination and early hydroxyurea treatment. This trial was registered at www.clinicaltrials.gov as NCT02286154.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess whether children with sickle cell anemia (SCA) receiving hydroxyurea achieve adequate seroprotection after measles vaccination, addressing a knowledge gap regarding vaccine efficacy in this population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study was conducted on children with SCA enrolled in the TREAT trial, examining antimeasles seroprotection after first and second measles vaccinations (MV1 and MV2).
analysis.methods: Seroprotection was measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) to detect immunoglobulin G (IgG) levels of ≥200 IU/L, with statistical analysis of odds ratios and P values to assess associations with age and hydroxyurea treatment initiation.
analysis.main_results: Seroprotection was achieved by 33 of 35 children (94%) after MV1 and by 46 of 50 (92%) after MV2. Each additional year of age at MV2 was associated with decreased odds of seroprotection (OR, 0.25; P = .02). Earlier hydroxyurea initiation was linked to increased seroprotection (OR, 4.4; P = .02).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that most children with SCA are adequately protected after measles vaccination, with seroprotection rates comparable to the general population, and that early hydroxyurea treatment may enhance vaccine response.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results inform measles vaccination strategies for children with SCA, highlighting the importance of timely vaccination and the potential benefit of early hydroxyurea treatment in improving seroprotection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the clear association between hydroxyurea initiation and seroprotection, supported by statistically significant odds ratios.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated measles vaccine seroprotection in children with sickle cell anemia (SCA) receiving hydroxyurea. It found that 94% of children achieved seroprotection after the first dose and 92% after the second. Age at vaccination was inversely associated with seroprotection, while earlier hydroxyurea treatment was linked to increased protection. These results suggest that timely vaccination and early hydroxyurea use may enhance measles immunity in SCA patients, aligning with general population outcomes. The study's retrospective design limits its strength, but the findings are supported by significant statistical associations.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,大多数镰状细胞贫血症(SCA)患儿在接受麻疹 疫苗接种后都能获得足够的血清保护,其血清保护率与一般人群相当,且早期羟基脲治疗可能增强疫苗的反应。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为镰状细胞贫血症(SCA)患儿的麻疹 疫苗接种策略提供了信息,强调了及时接种疫苗接种的重要性,并指出了早期羟基脲治疗可能在提高血清保护率方面具有潜在益处。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于本研究为回顾性设计,可能存在潜在的混杂因素,但证据强度较高,因为羟基脲治疗开始时间与血清保护之间的明确关联得到了统计学上显著的比值比支持。

papers.title: Cost of a Measles Outbreak in an Urban Shelter
papers.abstract: Importance: Measles outbreaks are costly and challenging to control. A measles outbreak associated with a Chicago, Illinois, shelter, which primarily affected shelter residents, resulted in substantial public health response costs, direct medical costs, and productivity losses. Objective: To evaluate the societal burden of the 2024 Chicago measles outbreak in terms of resources used and costs. Design, Setting, and Participants: This economic evaluation analyzed the costs of a shelter-associated measles outbreak in Chicago between March 7 and April 30, 2024, in terms of measles cases, contacts (children, adult residents, shelter personnel), and relevant agencies involved in the outbreak response. Exposure: Measles virus. Main Outcomes and Measures: Three types of costs were estimated in this limited societal cost analysis: (1) total response costs (personnel time, vaccination, quarantine space, transportation, laboratory testing, and other materials) incurred by the Chicago Department of Public Health and partner agencies; (2) direct medical costs (case isolation in hospitals, emergency department visits, treatment, interfacility emergency transportation, and infrastructure modifications); and (3) productivity losses due to isolation, quarantine, or informal caregiving (including number of days children were excluded from school). Results: There were 57 measles cases (including 30 females [52.6%]; median [IQR] age, 3 [1-22] years) and 3569 contacts (including 1837 females [51.6%]; median [IQR] age, 17 [7-30] years) associated with the shelter outbreak. The associated societal cost was $8 700 258, or $152 636 per measles case. Response costs included $1 798 780 in personnel costs, $1 397 976 in vaccination costs, $200 489 in laboratory testing costs, $104 263 in transportation costs, and $63 023 in other material costs. Direct medical costs were $4 399 639, and estimated productivity losses were $683 895, with 17 113 school days among children lost due to the outbreak. Conclusions and Relevance: This economic evaluation of a measles outbreak in a congregate setting found complex response challenges that contributed to substantial costs. This outbreak response was one of the most expensive in the measles postelimination era due to the large costs associated with vaccination and isolation and quarantine in hospitals. Though the outbreak placed a considerable cost burden on both public health and health care systems, rapid disease identification and mass vaccination among shelter residents prevented a more costly and larger outbreak. Strategies to reduce disease transmission and costs during outbreaks among undervaccinated populations living in congregate settings may include funding non-health care isolation and quarantine spaces and vaccinating new shelter residents on arrival.

Main Outcomes and Measures: Three types of costs were estimated in this limited societal cost analysis: (1) total response costs (personnel time, vaccination, quarantine space, transportation, laboratory testing, and other materials) incurred by the Chicago Department of Public Health and partner agencies; (2) direct medical costs (case isolation in hospitals, emergency department visits, treatment, interfacility emergency transportation, and infrastructure modifications); and (3) productivity losses due to isolation, quarantine, or informal caregiving (including number of days children were excluded from school). Results: There were 57 measles cases (including 30 females [52.6%]; median [IQR] age, 3 [1-22] years) and 3569 contacts (including 1837 females [51.6%]; median [IQR] age, 17 [7-30] years) associated with the shelter outbreak. The associated societal cost was $8 700 258, or $152 636 per measles case. Response costs included $1 798 780 in personnel costs, $1 397 976 in vaccination costs, $200 489 in laboratory testing costs, $104 263 in transportation costs, and $63 023 in other material costs. Direct medical costs were $4 399 639, and estimated productivity losses were $683 895, with 17 113 school days among children lost due to the outbreak. Conclusions and Relevance: This economic evaluation of a measles outbreak in a congregate setting found complex response challenges that contributed to substantial costs. This outbreak response was one of the most expensive in the measles postelimination era due to the large costs associated with vaccination and isolation and quarantine in hospitals. Though the outbreak placed a considerable cost burden on both public health and health care systems, rapid disease identification and mass vaccination among shelter residents prevented a more costly and larger outbreak. Strategies to reduce disease transmission and costs during outbreaks among undervaccinated populations living in congregate settings may include funding non-health care isolation and quarantine spaces and vaccinating new shelter residents on arrival.

papers.title: Clinical and laborator features of measles in adults
papers.abstract: Measles continues to cause periodic epidemic outbreaks at the present stage, affecting not only children but also the adult population, with the development of various complications, particularly in individuals with comorbid conditions. This necessitates a high level of awareness among healthcare professionals regarding this nosology and further scientific investigation in this field. Aim : To provide a clinical-laboratory characterization of measles in adults and endothelial dysfunction . Methods: A prospective study was conducted including 278 (100%) patients aged over 18 years diagnosed with measles and hospitalized in the Infectious Diseases Department of the multidisciplinary clinic of Tashkent State Medical University between March 2022 and December 2024. The presence of immunosuppression in this patient cohort was established, manifested by transient leukopenia in 62.9% of cases, lymphopenia in 47.5%, and thrombocytopenia in 45.3%. Results : In adults, measles at the present stage was characterized not only by classical clinical manifestations but also by atypical features, including the absence of typical stage progression in 16.5% of patients. Gastrointestinal complications, primarily diarrhea, were observed in 37.8% of patients, leading to dehydration. Hepatomegaly was detected in 38.1% of cases and was associated with cytolytic syndrome. A statistically significant elevation of vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A) (423.6 ± 37.6 pg/mL) and Creactive protein (CRP) levels (62.7 ± 2.9 mg/L) was observed in severe measles compared to moderate disease (276.4 ± 20.3 pg/mL and 48.3 ± 3.1 mg/L, respectively), indicating pronounced endothelial dysfunction. A correlation was identified between increased interleukin-1 (IL-1) levels and elevated CRP and VEGF-A concentrations, which predisposed to the development of pneumonia in 82 (29.5%) patients. Among these, 2.7% demonstrated elevated procalcitonin levels, suggesting a bacterial etiology of pneumonia. Conclusion : These findings indicate that marked endothelial dysfunction with the development of pathological angiogenesis represents one of the key pathogenetic mechanisms underlying pneumonia formation in adult patients with measles.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize measles in adults, focusing on clinical and laboratory features. Conducted in a prospective manner between March 2022 and December 2024, it included 278 hospitalized adult patients diagnosed with measles. The study found that measles in adults exhibited atypical features, such as the absence of typical stage progression in 16.5% of patients, and was associated with gastrointestinal complications, hepatomegaly, and endothelial dysfunction. A correlation was identified between elevated interleukin-1 levels and the development of pneumonia in 29.5% of patients, with 2.7% showing signs of bacterial etiology. papers.title_zh: 成年人麻疹的临床和实验室特征
papers.source_body_en: Measles continues to cause periodic epidemic outbreaks at the present stage, affecting not only children but also the adult population, with the development of various complications, particularly in individuals with comorbid conditions. This necessitates a high level of awareness among healthcare professionals regarding this nosology and further scientific investigation in this field. Aim : To provide a clinical-laboratory characterization of measles in adults and endothelial dysfunction . Methods: A prospective study was conducted including 278 (100%) patients aged over 18 years diagnosed with measles and hospitalized in the Infectious Diseases Department of the multidisciplinary clinic of Tashkent State Medical University between March 2022 and December 2024. The presence of immunosuppression in this patient cohort was established, manifested by transient leukopenia in 62.9% of cases, lymphopenia in 47.5%, and thrombocytopenia in 45.3%. Results : In adults, measles at the present stage was characterized not only by classical clinical manifestations but also by atypical features, including the absence of typical stage progression in 16.5% of patients. Gastrointestinal complications, primarily diarrhea, were observed in 37.8% of patients, leading to dehydration. Hepatomegaly was detected in 38.1% of cases and was associated with cytolytic syndrome. A statistically significant elevation of vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGF-A) (423.6 ± 37.6 pg/mL) and Creactive protein (CRP) levels (62.7 ± 2.9 mg/L) was observed in severe measles compared to moderate disease (276.4 ± 20.3 pg/mL and 48.3 ± 3.1 mg/L, respectively), indicating pronounced endothelial dysfunction. A correlation was identified between increased interleukin-1 (IL-1) levels and elevated CRP and VEGF-A concentrations, which predisposed to the development of pneumonia in 82 (29.5%) patients. Among these, 2.7% demonstrated elevated procalcitonin levels, suggesting a bacterial etiology of pneumonia. Conclusion : These findings indicate that marked endothelial dysfunction with the development of pathological angiogenesis represents one of the key pathogenetic mechanisms underlying pneumonia formation in adult patients with measles.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前,麻疹仍会导致周期性流行性暴发,不仅影响儿童,还影响成人,尤其在合并症患者中会引发各种并发症。这要求医疗专业人员对这一病种保持高度警觉,并进一步开展该领域的科学研究。目的:探讨成年人麻疹的临床-实验室特征及其与内皮功能障碍的关系。方法:本研究为前瞻性研究,纳入了2022年3月至2024年12月期间在塔什干州立医科大学多学科诊所感染科住院的278例(100%)年龄超过18岁的麻疹确诊患者。通过检测发现,这些患者存在免疫抑制现象,表现为62.9%的病例出现暂时性白细胞减少,47.5%出现淋巴细胞减少,45.3%出现血小板减少。结果:在成年人中,目前阶段的麻疹不仅表现出经典临床症状,还具有非典型特征,包括16.5%的患者未出现典型病程进展。37.8%的患者出现胃肠道并发症,主要为腹泻,导致脱水。38.1%的病例出现肝肿大,并与细胞溶解综合征相关。与中度疾病(276.4 ± 20.3 pg/mL和48.3 ± 3.1 mg/L)相比,重度麻疹患者的血管内皮生长因子A(VEGF-A)(423.6 ± 37.6 pg/mL)和C反应蛋白(CRP)水平(62.7 ± 2.9 mg/L)显著升高,提示明显的内皮功能障碍。研究发现,IL-1水平升高与CRP和VEGF-A浓度升高相关,这使得82例(29.5%)患者易发展为肺炎。其中,2.7%的患者表现出升高的降钙素原水平,提示肺炎可能具有细菌病因。结论:这些发现表明,显著的内皮功能障碍伴随病理性血管生成是成人麻疹患者肺炎形成的关键发病机制之一。

papers.title: Predicting measles outbreak magnitude via modeled population susceptibility evidence from pre-vaccination data
papers.abstract: We characterized pre-vaccination measles dynamics using a discrete-time mechanistic model that integrates incidence time series and demographic data to estimate key epidemiological parameters and to quantify the relationship between the reconstructed population susceptibility and the observed epidemic magnitude. Weekly reported measles incidence data from England and Wales and its five largest cities during the pre-vaccination era were analyzed. A discrete-time age-of-infection model incorporating seasonality was fitted for each year. Several parameters were fixed using values from the literature, while others were estimated via maximum likelihood. Reconstructed susceptibility at the start of each year (S 0 ), inferred from surveillance and demographic data, was evaluated as a predictor of subsequent observed outbreak magnitude. The model accurately reproduced the temporal dynamics of measles across all regions. Reconstructed S 0 was strongly associated with observed attack rates in the following year, demonstrating its practical value as a surveillance-based predictor of epidemic size. The discrete-time age-of-infection model enables exploration of the mechanisms underlying observed incidence and epidemic dynamics. It captures the feedback between the susceptible pool and outbreak amplitude and supports one-year-ahead predictions of observed outbreak magnitude based on reconstructed susceptibility.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a method for predicting measles outbreak magnitude using pre-vaccination data to understand population susceptibility dynamics.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A discrete-time mechanistic model was fitted for each year using weekly measles incidence data from England and Wales and its five largest cities during the pre-vaccination era.
analysis.methods: A discrete-time age-of-infection model incorporating seasonality was fitted for each year, with several parameters fixed using literature values and others estimated via maximum likelihood.
analysis.main_results: Reconstructed susceptibility at the start of each year (S 0 ) was strongly associated with observed attack rates in the following year, demonstrating its practical value as a surveillance-based predictor of epidemic size.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The model accurately reproduced the temporal dynamics of measles across all regions, capturing the feedback between the susceptible pool and outbreak amplitude.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the use of reconstructed susceptibility as a tool for one-year-ahead predictions of measles outbreak magnitude, enhancing surveillance and preparedness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on pre-vaccination data and assumes parameter stability over time, which may limit generalizability. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these assumptions.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a discrete-time mechanistic model that integrates measles incidence time series and demographic data to estimate population susceptibility and predict outbreak magnitude. The model was fitted for each year using weekly incidence data from England and Wales and its five largest cities during the pre-vaccination era. Parameters were fixed using literature values and estimated via maximum likelihood. The results showed that reconstructed susceptibility at the start of each year was strongly associated with observed attack rates in the following year, supporting its use as a surveillance-based predictor of epidemic size. The model accurately reproduced measles dynamics across all regions, capturing the feedback between susceptible populations and outbreak amplitude. The study's implications suggest that this approach could enhance public health preparedness by enabling one-year-ahead predictions of measles outbreaks. However, the reliance on pre-vaccination data and assumptions about parameter stability over time may limit generalizability, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在利用预疫苗接种数据开发一种方法,以预测麻疹 暴发规模,从而了解人群易感性动态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用英格兰和威尔士以及其五个最大城市在预疫苗接种时期的每周麻疹 发病率数据,为每个年份拟合了一个离散时间机制模型。
elements_zh.methods: 为每个年份拟合了一个包含季节性的离散时间感染年龄模型,其中一些参数使用文献中的值固定,而其他参数则通过最大似然估计进行拟合。
elements_zh.main_results: 重建的每年年初易感性(S 0 )与随后一年的观察到的发病强度有很强的相关性,证明其作为基于监测的疫情规模预测指标的实用价值。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该模型能够准确再现麻疹在所有地区的时序动态,捕捉了易感人群池与暴发幅度之间的反馈关系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持将重建的易感性作为预测麻疹 暴发规模的工具,用于一年期的预测,从而增强监测和应对准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于预疫苗接种数据,并假设参数随时间保持稳定,这可能限制其普遍适用性。由于这些假设,证据强度中等。

papers.title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
papers.journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

papers.title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
papers.source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.

papers.title: Sex-disaggregated analysis of measles incidence in Sierra Leone
papers.abstract: Measles remains a public health challenge in Sierra Leone, a country with a history of socio-economic and health system disruptions. Despite global efforts to control and eliminate measles, regional disparities and systemic challenges persist. This study aimed to assess sex-disaggregated age-standardised incidence rates of measles per 100,000 population, using data extracted from the WHO Health Equity Monitor via the HEAT toolkit, consistent with Global Burden of Disease (GBD) methodology to inform targeted public health interventions. We conducted a sex-disaggregated analysis using data from the World Health Organization (WHO) Equity Database and the Health Equity Assessment Toolkit (HEAT). Age-standardized incidence rates of measles per 100,000 population were calculated for males and females from 2000 to 2021. Key equity metrics, including absolute difference (D), incidence rate ratio (R), population attributable fraction (PAF), and population attributable risk (PAR), were computed to evaluate sex-based disparities in measles burden over the study period. The age-standardised incidence rate declined substantially from 1,908.1 cases per 100,000 population in 2000 to 43.4 cases per 100,000 population in 2021, representing an overall reduction of approximately 97.7%. The incidence rate decreased markedly to 136.5 cases per 100,000 population in 2005, increased to 620.6 and 625.3 cases per 100,000 population in 2010 and 2015, respectively, before declining again by 2021. Sex-disaggregated analysis revealed minimal inequality, with incidence rates of 1,946.2 (95% CI 679.1-4344.0), among females and 1,868.8 (95% CI 654.1-4032.5) among males in 2000, declining to 44.2 (95% CI 26.9-64.3) and 42.6 (95% CI 26.0-62.0), respectively, in 2021. The incidence rate ratio remained constant at 1.0 throughout the study period, while the population attributable fraction ranged from -2.1% to -1.9%, indicating minimal sex-based inequality in measles incidence. Although the age-standardised measles incidence rate declined substantially between 2000 and 2021, temporary increases in 2010 and 2015 indicate that progress remains vulnerable to disruptions in routine immunisation services. Geographic and economic inequalities persisted, whereas sex-based differences were minimal. Strengthening routine immunisation systems and implementing equity-focused strategies targeting underserved populations remain essential for achieving and sustaining measles elimination in Sierra Leone.

papers.title_zh: 塞拉利昂麻疹的性别分层分析
papers.source_body_en: Measles remains a public health challenge in Sierra Leone, a country with a history of socio-economic and health system disruptions. Despite global efforts to control and eliminate measles, regional disparities and systemic challenges persist. This study aimed to assess sex-disaggregated age-standardised incidence rates of measles per 100,000 population, using data extracted from the WHO Health Equity Monitor via the HEAT toolkit, consistent with Global Burden of Disease (GBD) methodology to inform targeted public health interventions. We conducted a sex-disaggregated analysis using data from the World Health Organization (WHO) Equity Database and the Health Equity Assessment Toolkit (HEAT). Age-standardized incidence rates of measles per 100,000 population were calculated for males and females from 2000 to 2021. Key equity metrics, including absolute difference (D), incidence rate ratio (R), population attributable fraction (PAF), and population attributable risk (PAR), were computed to evaluate sex-based disparities in measles burden over the study period. The age-standardised incidence rate declined substantially from 1,908.1 cases per 100,000 population in 2000 to 43.4 cases per 100,000 population in 2021, representing an overall reduction of approximately 97.7%. The incidence rate decreased markedly to 136.5 cases per 100,000 population in 2005, increased to 620.6 and 625.3 cases per 100,000 population in 2010 and 2015, respectively, before declining again by 2021. Sex-disaggregated analysis revealed minimal inequality, with incidence rates of 1,946.2 (95% CI 679.1-4344.0), among females and 1,868.8 (95% CI 654.1-4032.5) among males in 2000, declining to 44.2 (95% CI 26.9-64.3) and 42.6 (95% CI 26.0-62.0), respectively, in 2021. The incidence rate ratio remained constant at 1.0 throughout the study period, while the population attributable fraction ranged from -2.1% to -1.9%, indicating minimal sex-based inequality in measles incidence. Although the age-standardised measles incidence rate declined substantially between 2000 and 2021, temporary increases in 2010 and 2015 indicate that progress remains vulnerable to disruptions in routine immunisation services. Geographic and economic inequalities persisted, whereas sex-based differences were minimal. Strengthening routine immunisation systems and implementing equity-focused strategies targeting underserved populations remain essential for achieving and sustaining measles elimination in Sierra Leone.

papers.title: Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis: How Measles Virus Adapts to the Brain
papers.abstract: Measles virus (MeV) infection is mediated by two cellular receptors: signaling lymphocytic activation molecule family member 1 (SLAMF1, also known as CD150), expressed by immune cells, and nectin-4, expressed by epithelial cells. Infection of immune cells causes systemic disease and immune suppression, while infection of airway epithelial cells results in efficient transmission. In rare cases, MeV reaches the brain and slowly spreads in cells that do not express bona fide receptors, causing subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE). In the brains of persons with SSPE, multiple mutations of the MeV membrane fusion apparatus are selected that enable its triggering by host proteins acting as surrogate receptors. These mutations favor cell-to-cell spread, which promotes population-based MeV genome evolution and the formation of collective infectious units (CIUs). CIUs, which can rebalance their components and rapidly adapt to new environments, may support neuropathogenesis of other nonintegrating RNA viruses, in particular those with nonsegmented negative-strand genomes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study investigates how measles virus adapts to the brain during subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) and explores the mechanisms of viral adaptation in this context. The background highlights the dual cellular receptors used by measles virus for infection and the differing outcomes of infection in immune cells versus airway epithelial cells.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature on measles virus adaptation to the brain, focusing on SSPE cases. It examines the virus's behavior in the brains of individuals with SSPE, where it spreads in cells lacking bona fide receptors.
analysis.methods: The methods involve analyzing the molecular mechanisms of measles virus adaptation, particularly the mutations in the membrane fusion apparatus that allow the virus to trigger host proteins as surrogate receptors. The study also explores the implications of these mutations for viral spread and evolution.
analysis.main_results: In the brains of individuals with SSPE, multiple mutations of the measles virus membrane fusion apparatus are selected, enabling the virus to use host proteins as surrogate receptors. These mutations facilitate cell-to-cell spread and contribute to the formation of collective infectious units (CIUs).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these mutations as favoring cell-to-cell spread, which promotes population-based genome evolution and the formation of CIUs. This finding is novel as it suggests a mechanism by which measles virus adapts to the brain environment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the understanding of neuropathogenesis in other nonintegrating RNA viruses, particularly those with nonsegmented negative-strand genomes, and could have implications for the development of targeted therapies or diagnostic tools for SSPE.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on existing literature and does not include new experimental data, which may limit the strength of the conclusions. However, the evidence is grounded in well-documented molecular mechanisms and is considered to have moderate confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores how measles virus adapts to the brain during subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE). It highlights the dual cellular receptors used by the virus for infection and the differing outcomes of infection in immune cells versus airway epithelial cells. The study identifies mutations in the measles virus membrane fusion apparatus that enable the virus to use host proteins as surrogate receptors, facilitating cell-to-cell spread and the formation of collective infectious units (CIUs). These findings suggest a novel mechanism of viral adaptation in the brain environment and may have implications for understanding neuropathogenesis in other nonintegrating RNA viruses. The study is based on existing literature and does not include new experimental data, which may limit the strength of the conclusions, but the evidence is considered to have moderate confidence.

papers.title_zh: 亚急性硬化性全脑炎: 麻疹病毒如何适应大脑
papers.source_body_en: Measles virus (MeV) infection is mediated by two cellular receptors: signaling lymphocytic activation molecule family member 1 (SLAMF1, also known as CD150), expressed by immune cells, and nectin-4, expressed by epithelial cells. Infection of immune cells causes systemic disease and immune suppression, while infection of airway epithelial cells results in efficient transmission. In rare cases, MeV reaches the brain and slowly spreads in cells that do not express bona fide receptors, causing subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE). In the brains of persons with SSPE, multiple mutations of the MeV membrane fusion apparatus are selected that enable its triggering by host proteins acting as surrogate receptors. These mutations favor cell-to-cell spread, which promotes population-based MeV genome evolution and the formation of collective infectious units (CIUs). CIUs, which can rebalance their components and rapidly adapt to new environments, may support neuropathogenesis of other nonintegrating RNA viruses, in particular those with nonsegmented negative-strand genomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 麻疹病毒(麻疹病毒)感染通过两种细胞受体介导:由免疫细胞表达的信号淋巴细胞活化分子家族成员1(SLAMF1,也称为CD150),以及由上皮细胞表达的nectin-4。免疫细胞感染会导致全身性疾病和免疫抑制,而气道上皮细胞感染则会导致高效的传播。在极少数情况下,麻疹病毒会进入大脑并在不表达真正受体的细胞中缓慢扩散,从而引发亚急性硬化性全脑炎(亚急性硬化性全脑炎)。在患有亚急性硬化性全脑炎的患者大脑中,麻疹病毒膜融合装置的多个突变被选择,这些突变使得病毒能够通过宿主蛋白作为替代受体被触发。这些突变有利于细胞间传播,从而促进基于群体的麻疹病毒基因组 进化以及集体感染单位(CIUs)的形成。CIUs能够重新平衡其组分并迅速适应新环境,可能支持其他非整合RNA病毒的神经发病机制,特别是那些具有非分节负链基因组的病毒。

Volume 32, Number 10—October 2026 Research Wastewater Surveillance to Track Resurgent Measles Outbreak, Ontario, Canada, 2025 Suggested citation for this article Abstract The province of Ontario, Canada, experienced a major resurgent outbreak of measles in 2025. We conducted wastewater surveillance concurrently with clinical-based surveillance to track measles incidence in southwestern Ontario, adjacent to the United States. Measles virus (MeV) signal in wastewater was positively associated with clinical cases but did not provide early alert of changes in measles incidence when resolved by epidemiologic week. Assessment of virus partitioning showed MeV RNA was broadly distributed in the liquid phase but is most concentrated in the solids. We adapted an assay for differentiation of vaccine and wild-type MeV and used it to detect vaccine genotype measles after a vaccination campaign targeting underserved groups. We estimated MeV shedding in wastewater through sampling of sewer laterals serving a hospital treating measles infections. This outbreak is a case study in which we highlighted the use of wastewater surveillance for measles while supporting method development in real time. Wastewater surveillance (WS) gained traction during the COVID-19 pandemic as an effective and unbiased means to track community infection complementary to clinical testing. Sampling a wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) or locations within a sewershed revealed infection hotspots and tracked genetic variants (1). Wastewater yielded high-quality whole-genome SARS-CoV-2 sequence data (2); it is a resource for tracking disease spread and a complement to clinical data to identify disease burden and routes of pathogen transmission (3,4). WS has extended to additional targets, including respiratory diseases (5), foodborne illness (6), and diseases of emerging concern, such as mpox and highly pathogenic avian influenza (7–9). Public health officials warned of the increased potential for outbreaks of vaccine-preventable diseases (10). COVID-19 pandemic–associated disruptions and vaccine misinformation affected immunization campaigns, including measles vaccination programs (11). In 2025, Ontario experienced a large outbreak of measles; ≈2,400 confirmed cases were reported. Total cases nationwide reached 5,461 in 2025, positioning Canada as a hotspot for measles in North America (12). In November 2025, after 12 months of sustained transmission, Canada lost measles elimination status (13), a designation attained in 1998 (14). The 2025 outbreak of measles in Canada likely resulted from reduced vaccination coverage (15) and was the largest outbreak in 3 decades, overwhelming public health services, especially in southwestern Ontario, which experienced the highest caseload (16). Concurrent outbreaks in the US Southwest (17) and in Alberta, Canada (18), have raised interest in WS to complement clinical testing (19). WS accounts for community members who might be hesitant to seek medical care (20); that characteristic is relevant to measles, considering most cases in North America have been linked to close-knit undervaccinated communities (21,22). Studies since 2025 have highlighted the application of WS to track measles at a community level (23–26) and assays that differentiate between wild-type virus and vaccine genotypes (20,27). Despite early successes, many challenges persist to broader and more actionable adoption, including the clinical dynamics of viral shedding, viral partitioning within wastewater, and detection sensitivity (21), as well as the proximity of cases to monitored sewersheds. Here, we present a case study from a rural border municipality in southwestern Ontario demonstrating the application of WS for MeV during a measles outbreak. The outbreak persisted for >9 months, affording an opportunity for WS method development and enabling investigation to produce insights on MeV partitioning and on rates of viral shedding in wastewater. Our investigation used the outbreak as an opportunity to determine the feasibility of WS for MeV in a semirural setting and to help address challenges to its implementation. Sample Collection As part of an ongoing WS program, we collected composite wastewater samples over 24-hour periods, 3 per week, from the Leamington Pollution Control Centre (LPCC) in the Windsor-Essex region of Ontario, Canada, during February–November 2025. The LPCC serves the urban center of Leamington and accepts septage from residential septic tanks and frequently emptied storage tanks serving congregate living facilities in the rural area (≈30,000 total population served). We monitored sewer laterals draining Windsor Regional Hospital (WRH) using passive samplers (tampons) deployed 1–2 times/week. Passive samplers were submerged in the hospital effluent stream for 17–24 hours; at collection, they were transported to the laboratory for immediate processing (28). Sample Processing for MeV Monitoring We concentrated wastewater influent samples by filtration or affinity capture methods, and hospital effluent samples by centrifugation. After concentration, we extracted total nucleic acids and measured viral concentrations with quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR). We used an assay targeting the MeV nucleoprotein (N) gene for measles quantification (Appendix Table 1). We used a separate assay to measure pepper mild mottle virus in samples (28). We conducted sequencing to validate the identity of the amplicons obtained from the N gene of MeV (Appendix). Partitioning of Endogenous MeV in Wastewater To determine the partitioning of endogenous MeV in wastewater, we processed a 4-L postgrit wastewater sample collected from LPCC to derive fractions of solids, colloids, and supernatant (Figure 1). We performed partitioning calculations using 3 different assumptions: whole-sample basis, which considered wastewater composition; equal-mass basis; and operational volume basis, which reflects processing volumes commonly used in laboratory workflows (Appendix). Detection of Vaccine Genotype MeV We shipped raw influent samples weekly to the National Microbiology Laboratory (Winnipeg, MN, Canada) for additional analysis. Samples were processed as described previously (29), with minor modifications. To measure MeV wild-type and vaccine genotypes in wastewater, we used a multiplex assay developed for clinical detection (30). That triplex assay targets the large (L) gene for pan-MeV detection and the hemagglutinin (H) gene for wild-type and vaccine differentiation using a locked nucleic acid (LNA) probe for each target (Appendix). Additional Data Sources The WRH provided deidentified hospital admission and discharge dates for patients admitted with measles along with hospital water usage data. We obtained weekly measles case data from the Windsor-Essex County Health Unit (WECHU). We deemed symptomatic persons who sought care for fever; maculopapular rash for >3 days; and cough, coryza, or conjunctivitis, along with laboratory confirmation of infection, as having confirmed cases of measles. We also considered clinically compatible signs and symptoms in a person with an epidemiologic link to a laboratory-confirmed confirmed measles cases (31). The WECHU provided weekly vaccination data consisting of the number of measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccines administered in a targeted vaccination campaign. LPCC provided metadata (pH, temperature, flow) for each sample and the septage volume deposited at LPCC by private companies. The Windsor Regional Hospital Research Ethics Board (REB no. 25-529) and the University of Windsor Research Ethics Board (REB no. 25-127) provided research ethics approval. Estimation of Viral Shedding We estimated viral shedding rates for MeV using passive samplers deployed at WRH as described previously (28), with slight modifications. Because it is challenging to measure viral gene concentration in sampled flows using passive samplers, we calculated the concentration of MeV in hospital effluent using a previously reported mean suspended solids value for hospital effluent (32) and accounting for MeV partitioning. We determined flow rates using hospital water use. We used admission and discharge times for MeV hospitalizations to determine both the number of hospitalized patients and the temporal overlap value. We reported shedding rates in log10 gene copies per day per person. We used median estimated shedding rate, average weekly flow, and MeV concentration to create an estimated weekly case count for LPCC sewershed (Appendix). Statistical Methods We performed statistical analyses using R version 4.5.1 (The R Project for Statistical Computing, https://www.r-project.org). We analyzed data collected during February–July 2025, ending with the last reported measles case in Leamington (Appendix). Partitioning of MeV in Wastewater We determined the distribution of endogenous MeV across settled solids, colloids, and supernatant fractions of wastewater. We calculated MeV distribution using 3 different approaches (Figure 2). When accounting for typical wastewater composition (99.96% liquid and 0.04% solids), we detected most of the MeV signal (+SE) in the supernatant (91.20% +7.22%), followed by the colloids (8.58% +1.24%) and settled solids (0.25% +0.05%) (Figure 2, panel A). That approach was influenced by the disproportionate volume of the liquid phase and might not reflect the concentration potential of each matrix. On an equivalent-mass basis (1 g each of solids and liquids), we found the highest concentration of MeV in the solids (95.95% +17.75%), with lower proportions in supernatant (13.31% +1.05%) and colloids (1.25% +0.18%) (Figure 2, panel B). However, routine enrichment methods do not process equivalent masses, which limited the relevance of our comparison. We used weight and volume units typically processed in laboratory workflows (0.25 g for solids, 150 mL for colloids, and 37 mL for supernatant) for the final calculation. Under operational conditions, we recovered most of the MeV signal from the supernatant (69.92% +5.53%), followed by colloids (26.67 +3.86%), and solids (3.40% +0.63%) (Figure 2, panel C). Those findings demonstrated that MeV RNA was broadly distributed in the liquid phase but was most concentrated in the solids. However, when considering viral recovery in accordance with standard enrichment protocol, the supernatant yields the highest amount of MeV RNA because it contains the largest volume, supporting its use for optimal detection. Wastewater Surveillance of MeV at Outbreak Location WS of MeV began in March 2025, after reports of cases in Windsor-Essex. We conducted retrospective analysis of archived samples from February onward. The first wastewater samples that tested positive for MeV were collected on March 7, 2025 (Figure 3); samples tested positive through mid-August 2025. MeV wastewater signal showed a strong positive correlation with cases during February–July 2025 for normalized (Spearman correlation coefficient [ρ] = 0.77 [95% CI 0.51–0.87]; p<0.001) and raw (ρ = 0.77 [95% CI 0.49–0.90]; p<0.001) signal. Correlations between wastewater signal derived from a subset of samples concentrated with affinity capture techniques corroborated that result for normalized (ρ = 0.84 [95% CI 0.60–0.94]; p<0.001) and raw (ρ = 0.87 [95% CI 0.68–0.95]; p<0.001) signal. The increased correlation for that sample set could result from the truncated dataset or the use of affinity capture methods, which are more effective than filtration in concentrating MeV. We observed the correlation even where populations might underutilize health services, which likely contributed to underreporting of measles cases (33). We confirmed the identity of amplicons obtained by qRT-PCR by sequencing. Sequence alignments determined using BLAST (https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi) confirmed that the reads we obtained shared ≥99% identity with MeV N gene. Previous research has shown WS to be a leading indicator of disease incidence (34–38). We used time-lagged cross-correlation (TLCC) to determine if WS for measles is a leading indicator of clinical reporting. We found the highest association when MeV wastewater signal lagged clinical cases by 1 week for pepper mild mottle virus normalized and raw signal (Appendix Figures 1, 2). However, correlations at a lag of 1 week were not different from the correlations of aligned time series (ρ = 0.79 for raw and ρ = 0.78 for normalized signal). TLCC suggested that wastewater was not a leading indicator of measles cases for data aggregated by epidemiologic week. Weekly averaging or potential delays in the detection of MeV signals at LPCC associated with septic hauling could have obscured lead time. The WS approach failed to warn of outbreak onset, potentially because of RNA degradation in archived samples (39), 3 times weekly sampling frequency, method sensitivity, or the rural nature of the sewershed where the outbreak occurred. Modeling Determinants of MeV RNA Concentration in Wastewater Samples The gamma generalized linear model (GLM) explained 75% of the variation in normalized MeV (pseudo R2 = 0.75). Clinical cases were the only statistically significant predictor. Cases had a positive influence on MeV signal (β = 2.05 +0.77; z = 2.67; p = 0.008); an increase in cases by 1 SD resulted in ≈8-fold increase in normalized MeV. Other fixed effects (flow, pH, epidemiologic week, and vaccination rates) were not statistically significant (Appendix Table 2). We fitted a separate gamma GLM to a truncated dataset (n = 14), including cases and total sewage volume as predictors of normalized measles concentration (Appendix Table 3). The model explained 72% of variability in normalized MeV concentration (pseudo R2 = 0.72). Residuals simulated in DHARMa (https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=DHARMa) showed evidence of mild heteroskedasticity (Appendix Table 3). Analysis of the truncated dataset corroborated that cases are the most significant factor explaining variability in normalized MeV concentration at the WWTP; that finding reinforced the use of WS as an independent measure of disease within a community. The total volume of sewage deposited at the WWTP was a significant predictor of MeV signal. Septic sewage could contain MeV RNA, contributing to MeV signal at the WWTP when tanks are emptied frequently. Delivery delays the arrival of viral material to the WWTP and likely contributes to the observed lag at epidemiologic week temporal granularity (Appendix Figure 3). We ran Spearman correlations between physicochemical parameters of wastewater, MeV signal, and the total volume deposited by septic sewage hauling companies each week; those analyses showed that the volumes deposited by select companies and MeV signal were correlated (Appendix Figure 4). Total volume for company 3 was correlated with both normalized (ρ = 0.83; p<0.001) and raw (ρ = 0.78; p = 0.002) MeV signal in wastewater. We also observed a correlation between the total volume of all septage deposited and both raw (ρ = 0.78; p = 0.002) and normalized (ρ = 0.81; p<0.001) MeV signal. Those correlations indicated that septic hauling might contribute to the MeV signal at LPCC. We tested the association on a dataset that included only days when septage deliveries coincided with wastewater sample collection (Appendix Figure 5). Correlations were weaker and nonsignificant when restricted to days with coincident sampling, (Appendix Figure 6). Thus, septic deliveries play a more minor role in explaining wastewater signal than the first correlation analysis suggested. Vaccine Genotype Detection We performed an assay that targets a single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) in the MeV H gene to distinguish vaccine genotype MeV RNA from wild-type MeV RNA (30). We treated the assay as a binary indicator of the presence of vaccine genotype MeV RNA. We detected vaccine genotype MeV in Leamington wastewater ≈6 weeks after the start of vaccination campaigns and ≈4 weeks after the intensification of the vaccination campaign (Figure 4). Research in MeV shedding dynamics after vaccination indicates that shedding can start >1 day after inoculation and can persist for up to 14 days in urine and 29 days in nasopharyngeal swabs (40,41). Those values partially explain the delay between the start of the vaccination campaign and the first detections in wastewater but are unlikely to account for the full lag. In this outbreak, the vaccination campaign focused on agri-food workers in bunkhouses served by frequently emptied septic tanks; thus, the delayed delivery of MeV RNA to the WWTP could explain the delay. The frequency of septic hauling could contribute to the temporal dynamics of WS for rural sewersheds. MeV Shedding and Case Estimation The city of Windsor was less affected by the measles outbreak, consistent with higher vaccination rates in urban centers (42,43). Data from cases and wastewater signal were sporadic; each supported lower incidence in Windsor (data not shown). Simultaneous detections in hospital effluent at a campus of WRH and hospitalizations enabled us to estimate viral shedding rates on 6 dates (Table). Shedding rates ranged over 4 orders of magnitude; median shedding rate was 11.15 log10 gene copies/person/day. For 1 hospitalized patient, we estimated shedding on consecutive days. Shedding nominally decreased between measurements, but that decrease could be measurement error. Studies have shown that shedding rates of measles vary over the course of infection and between patients, generally declining in titers over time (44,45). analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the utility of wastewater surveillance in tracking measles outbreaks and understanding the dynamics of measles virus (MeV) in the environment, particularly in relation to clinical case reporting.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in southwestern Ontario, Canada, from February to July 2025, focusing on wastewater treatment plants and sewersheds. It included a targeted vaccination campaign and clinical surveillance data to identify infection hotspots and genetic variants.
analysis.methods: Wastewater samples were collected and processed using quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR) to measure viral concentrations. An assay targeting the MeV nucleoprotein (N) gene was used for quantification, and a triplex assay targeting the large (L) gene for pan-MeV detection and the hemagglutinin (H) gene for genotype differentiation was employed. Partitioning calculations were performed using three assumptions: whole-sample basis, equal-mass basis, and operational volume basis.
analysis.main_results: MeV RNA was found to be most concentrated in the solids of wastewater samples, with 95.95% of the signal detected on an equivalent-mass basis. The MeV wastewater signal showed a strong positive correlation with clinical cases, with Spearman correlation coefficients of 0.77 (95% CI 0.51–0.87) for normalized signal and 0.77 (95% CI 0.49–0.90) for raw signal. Correlations were also observed between MeV signal and the total volume of septage deposited by septic sewage hauling companies.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrated that wastewater surveillance can effectively track measles outbreaks and genetic variants, with the highest MeV concentration in solids. The strong correlation between wastewater signal and clinical cases suggests its potential as a tool for early outbreak detection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results support the use of wastewater surveillance as a complementary method for measles monitoring, particularly in areas with underutilized health services where case underreporting may occur.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study used a truncated dataset and relied on assumptions about wastewater composition, which may affect the generalizability of results. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations and the potential for measurement error.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of wastewater surveillance in tracking measles outbreaks in southwestern Ontario, Canada, during 2025. The research aimed to understand how measles virus (MeV) distributes in wastewater and its correlation with clinical cases. Methods included qRT-PCR and specialized assays to detect MeV RNA and differentiate between vaccine and wild-type genotypes. Results showed that MeV RNA was most concentrated in wastewater solids, with strong correlations between wastewater signal and clinical cases, both normalized and raw. The study also found that MeV signal correlated with the volume of septage deposited by septic sewage companies. These findings suggest that wastewater surveillance can be a valuable tool for measles monitoring, especially in areas with underreporting. However, the study's reliance on assumptions and a truncated dataset limits the confidence in the results, indicating moderate evidence strength.

Partitioning calculations were performed using three assumptions: whole-sample basis, equal-mass basis, and operational volume basis.
elements_en.main_results: MeV RNA was found to be most concentrated in the solids of wastewater samples, with 95.95% of the signal detected on an equivalent-mass basis. The MeV wastewater signal showed a strong positive correlation with clinical cases, with Spearman correlation coefficients of 0.77 (95% CI 0.51–0.87) for normalized signal and 0.77 (95% CI 0.49–0.90) for raw signal. Correlations were also observed between MeV signal and the total volume of septage deposited by septic sewage hauling companies.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrated that wastewater surveillance can effectively track measles outbreaks and genetic variants, with the highest MeV concentration in solids. The strong correlation between wastewater signal and clinical cases suggests its potential as a tool for early outbreak detection.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results support the use of wastewater surveillance as a complementary method for measles monitoring, particularly in areas with underutilized health services where case underreporting may occur.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study used a truncated dataset and relied on assumptions about wastewater composition, which may affect the generalizability of results. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations and the potential for measurement error.
