papers.title_zh: 废水监测用于追踪加拿大安大略省西南部2025年回升的麻疹病毒暴发
papers.source_body_en: We conducted wastewater surveillance concurrently with clinical-based surveillance to track measles incidence in southwestern Ontario, adjacent to the United States. This outbreak is a case study in which we highlighted the use of wastewater surveillance for measles while supporting method development in real time. Here, we present a case study from a rural border municipality in southwestern Ontario demonstrating the application of WS for MeV during a measles outbreak. The outbreak persisted for >9 months, affording an opportunity for WS method development and enabling investigation to produce insights on MeV partitioning and on rates of viral shedding in wastewater. Sample Processing for MeV Monitoring We concentrated wastewater influent samples by filtration or affinity capture methods, and hospital effluent samples by centrifugation. We used an assay targeting the MeV nucleoprotein (N) gene for measles quantification (Appendix Table 1). We used a separate assay to measure pepper mild mottle virus in samples (28). We conducted sequencing to validate the identity of the amplicons obtained from the N gene of MeV (Appendix). To measure MeV wild-type and vaccine genotypes in wastewater, we used a multiplex assay developed for clinical detection (30). Disclaimer: Early release articles are not considered as final versions. Any changes will be reflected in the online version in the month the article is officially released. papers.abstract_zh: 我们同时进行了废水监测和基于临床的麻疹病毒监测,以追踪2025年加拿大安大略省西南部邻近美国地区的麻疹病毒暴发。这项监测是一个案例研究,我们强调了废水监测在麻疹病毒监测中的应用,同时支持实时方法开发。在这里,我们展示了一个来自加拿大安大略省西南部农村边境市镇的案例研究,说明在麻疹病毒暴发期间使用废水监测(WS)来检测麻疹病毒(MeV)。该麻疹病毒暴发持续了>9个月,为废水监测方法的开发提供了机会,并使调查能够产生关于麻疹病毒在废水中的分布以及病毒在废水中的释放速率的见解。麻疹病毒监测样本处理我们通过过滤或亲和捕获方法浓缩废水进水样本,通过离心处理医院废水样本。我们使用针对麻疹病毒核蛋白(N)基因的检测方法来测量麻疹病毒的信号(附录表1)。我们还使用单独的检测方法来测量样本中的辣椒轻斑点病毒(28)。我们进行了测序以验证从麻疹病毒N基因获得的扩增子的身份(附录)。为了测量废水中的麻疹病毒野生型和突变型基因型,我们使用了一种为临床检测开发的多重检测方法(30)。免责声明:早期发布文章不被视为最终版本。任何更改将在文章正式发布当月的在线版本中反映。第32卷,第10期——2026年10月研究:用于追踪加拿大安大略省2025年回升的麻疹病毒暴发的废水监测建议引用本文:摘要加拿大安大略省在2025年经历了一次重大的麻疹病毒暴发回升。废水中的麻疹病毒信号与临床病例呈正相关,但具体数据未完整呈现。

Volume 32, Number 10—October 2026 Dispatch Whole-Genome Sequencing of Measles Virus from 2025 Outbreak, Texas, USA Suggested citation for this article Abstract We sequenced measles-positive samples from the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA, and identified the expansion of a closely related genotype D8 lineage within broader strain diversity from North America. F:H419R was used as a lineage-associated genomic surveillance marker. Our findings demonstrate that whole-genome sequencing can strengthen measles surveillance and enhance outbreak investigations. Measles virus importations continue to cause outbreaks in undervaccinated communities in the United States despite elimination since 2000 (1). In early 2025, the Texas Department of State Health Services reported the state’s largest measles outbreak after elimination, centered in Gaines County and neighboring West Texas communities (2). Epidemiologic reports indicated 762 confirmed measles cases; more than half occurred in Gaines County, and most cases were among children, adolescents, and persons who were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status (3). The outbreak occurred during expanded measles activity in North America, raising questions about local expansion, interstate relatedness, and the utility of whole-genome sequencing (WGS) to resolve transmission patterns beyond routine genotyping. Routine measles molecular surveillance commonly relies on the 450-nucleotide region of the nucleoprotein gene (N-450), which supports genotype and distinct sequence identifier (DSId) assignment. However, N-450 provides limited resolution of transmission chains during large outbreaks involving closely related viruses (4). We used WGS to characterize the measles outbreak in Texas and assessed genomic diversity and genomic relatedness to other measles virus genomes from North America. We performed tiled amplicon-based sequencing on 491 reverse transcription PCR–positive measles samples (Appendix). After quality assessment, 368 measles virus genomes from 359 persons met the predefined coverage threshold for phylogenetic analysis; 9 persons each had 2 samples sequenced (Appendix Table 1). Among the 359 persons with sequenced samples and epidemiologic metadata, 204 (56.8%) were unvaccinated, 139 (38.7%) had unknown vaccination status, 7 (2.0%) had received 1 measles vaccine dose, and 9 (2.5%) had received 2 measles vaccine doses (Appendix Table 2). We determined vaccination status by using patient records. Patients without confirmed vaccination status were classified as unknown. We performed an exploratory genome-wide association study to evaluate if measles variants were associated with vaccination status, but we did not detect any variants significantly associated with vaccination status; however, our analysis was underpowered. We performed a maximum-likelihood phylogenic analysis by using the 368 sequenced measles virus genomes. N-450 DSIds were available for 240 measles virus genomes, of which 220 (92%) were DSId 9171, a specific measles virus lineage belonging to the D8 genotype. We assigned epidemiologic weeks to measles virus genomes by using Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report numbering (5). Maximum-likelihood phylogenetic analysis revealed that measles virus genomes from Texas formed a closely related genotype D8 lineage (Figure 1, panel A). Pairwise single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) distances ranged from 0–15 SNPs (median 3 SNPs), supporting close genetic relatedness among outbreak genomes (Figure 1, panel B). To estimate the time to most recent common ancestor (tMRCA) for the measles virus genomes associated with the outbreak in Texas, we performed a molecular clock analysis. We did not use tMRCA estimates from the Texas measles virus genomes alone to infer introduction timing because our molecular clock analysis revealed weak temporal signal after we excluded the temporally distant D8 reference genome (Appendix Figure 1). Early measles virus genomes from epidemiologic weeks 5–8 were concentrated in Gaines County, Texas, the outbreak epicenter. We later observed closely related genomes in nearby and more distant Texas counties (Appendix Figure 2). Those results support early localized amplification followed by wider spread, although multiple closely related introductions cannot be ruled out (6). To provide genomic surveillance context, we conducted a targeted evaluation of the Fusion gene H419R substitution (F:H419R), fixed in all measles viral genomes from Texas, rather than a comprehensive genome-wide screen for recurrent, homoplasic substitution, or substitutions of functional effect. To place F:H419R in broader context, we screened publicly available genotype D8 whole genomes with adequate Fusion gene coverage >12,500 bp of total genome coverage with an unambiguous call for the fusion gene codon encoding residue 419). We detected F:H419R among recent publicly available D8 measles virus genomes (Figure 2, panel A; Appendix Table 3). The proportion of D8 genomes with the F:H419R substitution increased from 2% (1/49) in 2023 to 8.5% (10/118) in 2024 and 65.4% (34/52) in 2025 (Appendix Figure 3). Although residue 419 has prior residue-level annotation (7), this study did not evaluate functional, immunologic, vaccine-effectiveness, transmission, or clinical consequences. Selection analysis identified 2 polymerase-gene codons, which we interpreted as subclade markers rather than evidence of immune escape or functional adaptation (Appendix Figure 4). We placed the measles genomes from Texas in the global context by using the Nextstrain measles workflow (https://github.com/nextstrain/measles). To reduce geographic and temporal sampling imbalance, we subsampled genomes to <30 per country–year group. Consequently, the phylogeny includes only a representative subset of 2025 measles genomes from the United States (Figure 2, panel B). Measles virus genomes from Texas clustered with contemporaneous genomes from Utah, USA, and the Netherlands (Figure 2, panel B). We analyzed a comparative dataset including genomes from Texas, Arizona, Utah, South Carolina, and other jurisdictions in North America. We observed high callable coverage across most coding regions including N-450 and the Fusion gene but more variable coverage in the matrix–fusion noncoding region (MF-NCR) (Appendix Figure 5). Masking MF-NCR positions did not alter major phylogenetic clustering, indicating that uneven coverage did not account for the broad phylogenetic structure (Appendix Figure 6). The focal measles virus genomes from North America were interspersed with other related D8 measles virus genotypes (Figure 3). Root-to-tip regression indicated limited temporal signal in state-specific datasets and moderate temporal structure in the focal North American lineage (Appendix Table 4). TreeTime (https://github.com/neherlab/treetime) estimated a tMRCA of June 14, 2024 (90% CI December 24, 2023–December 12, 2024) for the expanding North American D8 measles virus lineage, supporting recent shared ancestry and expansion of a sublineage in Texas within broader North American D8 measles virus diversity. We observed lower pairwise SNP distances within Texas than between Texas and Utah or Arizona, indicating a more compact genetic cluster among measles virus genomes associated with the outbreak in Texas (Figure 4; Appendix Table 5). Measles virus genomes from Arizona and Utah were related to genomes from Texas but demonstrated heterogeneous phylogenetic placement. In contrast, measles virus genomes from South Carolina formed a distinct sublineage within broader North American D8 diversity. Those findings support local expansion of a closely related Texas lineage within wider North American D8 diversity, with distinguishable but related sublineages circulating concurrently in other jurisdictions. Our genomic investigation of the largest after elimination measles outbreak in Texas demonstrated expansion of a closely related genotype D8 lineage and demonstrated the added resolution of WGS beyond routine N-450 genotyping. Measles virus genomes from Texas clustered closely with other D8 measles genotypes from North America, including those from Arizona, Utah, and South Carolina. However, incomplete regional sampling, limited WGS availability from contemporaneous outbreaks, variable MF-NCR coverage, low sequence diversity, and molecular-clock outliers prevented definitive inference of geographic origin or transmission direction. We therefore interpreted molecular clock estimates as temporal context rather than evidence of jurisdictional source or directionality. The F:H419R mutation was fixed among measles genomes from Texas and was detected among recent publicly available D8 whole genomes, supporting its use as a lineage-associated genomic surveillance marker. Because publicly available data are enriched for WGS whereas routine measles surveillance commonly relies on N-450 sequencing, our analysis cannot estimate the prevalence or geographic distribution of this mutation. Our findings demonstrate how WGS can distinguish closely related measles virus lineages that routine N-450 genotyping cannot resolve and complement epidemiologic investigation during large outbreaks. Expanding timely, geographically representative WGS and integrating genomic and epidemiologic data could strengthen measles surveillance. Dr. Juntawong leads genomic epidemiology analyses of viral pathogen outbreaks at the Texas Department of State Health Services. Her work focuses on next-generation sequencing, pathogen genomics, and molecular surveillance to support public health decision-making. Acknowledgments We thank the Microbial Genomics Team, Astrid Romero, Michael Jost, Shivangi Vayla, and Mayela Pedrueza; Genetic Sequencing Branch members Jessica Paul, Joel Wadleigh, and Sydney Zacharias; and Carolyn Crisp for technical assistance and suggestions. We thank Erin Young, Kelly Oakeson, and the Utah Public Health Laboratory for assistance with Cecret pipeline setup and for providing genome sequences. Canada measles whole-genome sequences were provided by the Public Health Agency of Canada (Joanne Hiebert), Alberta Precision Laboratories Public Health Laboratory (Kevin Fonseca and Tarah Lynch), and the British Columbia Centre for Disease Control Public Health Laboratory program (Agatha Jassem, Branco Cheung, and John Tyson). Texas outbreak genome sequences are publicly available in the National Center for Biotechnology Information database (BioProject accession no. PRJNA1435643). analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the 2025 measles outbreak in Texas, USA, to understand the genomic diversity and relatedness of the measles virus to other North American strains. The research addressed the need for enhanced measles surveillance and outbreak investigations using whole-genome sequencing (WGS).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved sequencing measles-positive samples from the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA, focusing on 368 genomes from 359 persons. The outbreak was centered in Gaines County and neighboring West Texas communities, and the study assessed genomic diversity and relatedness to other measles virus genomes from North America.
analysis.methods: The study used WGS to characterize the measles outbreak in Texas, including tiled amplicon-based sequencing and maximum-likelihood phylogenetic analysis. The researchers also conducted a molecular clock analysis and an exploratory genome-wide association study to evaluate the association with vaccination status.
analysis.main_results: The study found that the measles virus genomes from Texas formed a closely related genotype D8 lineage. The F:H419R mutation was fixed among measles genomes from Texas and was detected among recent publicly available D8 whole genomes. The proportion of D8 genomes with the F:H419R substitution increased significantly over time.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the findings demonstrated the added resolution of WGS beyond routine N-450 genotyping and supported the use of the F:H419R mutation as a genomic surveillance marker. The study highlighted the utility of WGS in strengthening measles surveillance and enhancing outbreak investigations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings could inform the strengthening of measles surveillance and the use of WGS to resolve transmission patterns beyond routine genotyping. The study suggested that expanding timely, geographically representative WGS could improve public health responses to measles outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledged that the analysis was underpowered for detecting variants associated with vaccination status and that the molecular clock analysis revealed weak temporal signal. The study's findings were based on a specific lineage and may not be generalizable to other measles virus lineages.

analysis.summary_en: This study sequenced measles virus genomes from the 2025 outbreak in Texas, USA, to understand genomic diversity and relatedness to other North American strains. The findings demonstrated the utility of whole-genome sequencing in strengthening measles surveillance and enhancing outbreak investigations.

elements_en.main_results: The study found that the measles virus genomes from Texas formed a closely related genotype D8 lineage. The F:H419R mutation was fixed among measles genomes from Texas and was detected among recent publicly available D8 whole genomes. The proportion of D8 genomes with the F:H419R substitution increased significantly over time.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the findings demonstrated the added resolution of WGS beyond routine N-450 genotyping and supported the use of the F:H419R mutation as a genomic surveillance marker. The study highlighted the utility of WGS in strengthening measles surveillance and enhancing outbreak investigations.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings could inform the strengthening of measles surveillance and the use of WGS to resolve transmission patterns beyond routine genotyping. The study suggested that expanding timely, geographically representative WGS could improve public health responses to measles outbreaks.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledged that the analysis was underpowered for detecting variants associated with vaccination status and that the molecular clock analysis revealed weak temporal signal. The study's findings were based on a specific lineage and may not be generalizable to other measles virus lineages.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究对2025年德克萨斯州美国的麻疹阳性样本进行了测序,重点关注了来自359名个体的368个基因组。该暴发主要集中在盖恩斯县及其邻近的西德克萨斯社区,研究评估了其基因组多样性及其与其他北美麻疹病毒病毒的基因组相关性。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究使用全基因组测序(WGS)对德克萨斯州的麻疹 暴发进行了特征分析,包括基于拼接扩增的测序和最大似然系统发育分析。研究人员还进行了分子钟分析和探索性的全基因组关联研究,以评估其与疫苗接种状态的关联性。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究发现,德克萨斯州的麻疹病毒病毒基因组形成了一个密切相关D8谱系。F:H419R取代在德克萨斯州的所有麻疹病毒中固定,并且在最近公开的D8全基因组中被检测到。具有F:H419R取代的D8病毒基因组比例随时间显著增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,这些研究结果表明全基因组测序(WGS)在常规N-450基因型分析之外提供了更高的分辨率,并支持将F:H419R取代作为基因组监测标记的使用。本研究强调了WGS在加强麻疹的监测和提高暴发调查效果方面的实用性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以用于加强麻疹的监测,并利用WGS解决常规基因型分析之外的免疫学模式。本研究建议,扩大及时、地理代表性强的WGS可以改善对麻疹 暴发的公共卫生响应。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认,检测与疫苗接种状态相关的变体的分析存在样本量不足的问题,且分子钟分析显示了较弱的时间信号。本研究的结果基于特定谱系,可能无法推广到其他麻疹病毒谱系。

papers.source_body_en: Our findings demonstrate that whole-genome sequencing can strengthen measles surveillance and enhance outbreak investigations. We used WGS to characterize the measles outbreak in Texas and assessed genomic diversity and genomic relatedness to other measles virus genomes from North America. We performed an exploratory genome-wide association study to evaluate if measles variants were associated with vaccination status, but we did not detect any variants significantly associated with vaccination status; however, our analysis was underpowered. Those results support early localized amplification followed by wider spread, although multiple closely related introductions cannot be ruled out (6). To provide genomic surveillance context, we conducted a targeted evaluation of the Fusion gene H419R substitution (F:H419R), fixed in all measles viral genomes from Texas, rather than a comprehensive genome-wide screen for recurrent, homoplasic substitution, or substitutions of functional effect. Although residue 419 has prior residue-level annotation (7), this study did not evaluate functional, immunologic, vaccine-effectiveness, transmission, or clinical consequences. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the ongoing spread of measles virus in the United States, highlighting the need for continued surveillance and understanding of its epidemiological patterns.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a descriptive analysis of measles virus spread across the United States, focusing on recent outbreaks and their geographic distribution.
analysis.methods: The methods involve reviewing public health data and reports to document the spread of measles virus, with no specific laboratory or statistical procedures detailed in the provided evidence.
analysis.main_results: The study reports that measles continues to spread in the United States, with specific mention of outbreaks in various regions and an increase in cases compared to previous years.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as evidence of persistent measles transmission despite vaccination efforts, noting the novelty of the continued spread in a country with high immunization rates.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for enhanced measles surveillance and targeted vaccination campaigns to control outbreaks and prevent further spread.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported data without detailed statistical analysis, and the evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the ongoing spread of measles virus in the United States, emphasizing the need for continued surveillance and understanding of its epidemiological patterns. The research is a descriptive analysis of recent outbreaks and their geographic distribution, based on public health data. The authors interpret the findings as evidence of persistent measles transmission despite high vaccination rates, noting the novelty of this situation. The study's results inform the importance of enhanced surveillance and targeted vaccination efforts to control outbreaks. However, the evidence is limited by its observational nature and lack of detailed statistical analysis, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究探讨了麻疹病毒在美国持续传播的情况,强调了对监测的持续关注以及对其流行病学模式的理解需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对麻疹病毒在美国传播的描述性分析,重点关注近期暴发及其地理分布。
elements_zh.methods: 研究方法涉及审查公共卫生数据和报告以记录麻疹病毒的传播情况,但提供的证据中未详细说明特定的实验室或统计程序。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究指出麻疹在美国持续传播,特别提到不同地区出现的暴发,并且病例数量较往年有所增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为尽管有疫苗接种努力,麻疹仍持续传播的证据,指出在美国高疫苗接种率的国家中持续传播的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明需要加强麻疹的监测以及有针对性的疫苗接种活动,以控制暴发并防止其进一步传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其依赖于报告数据而没有详细的统计分析,由于研究结果的观察性质,证据强度中等。

papers.abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

papers.title: Development and Internal Validation of a Clinical Prediction Model for Severe Measles Outcomes Among Hospitalized Children During the 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh
papers.abstract: This study will develop and internally validate a clinical prediction model for severe measles outcomes among hospitalized children during the 2026 outbreak in Bangladesh. Routine hospital records from Chittagong Medical College Hospital will be used for patients under 18 years admitted from March to October 2026. Demographic, clinical, vaccination, and nutritional factors will be assessed as predictors. Severe outcome will include death, intensive care admission, mechanical ventilation, severe pneumonia requiring oxygen, or severe neurological complications. A multivariable logistic regression model with 1,000 bootstrap samples will be used. Model discrimination and calibration will be assessed. If appropriate, the model will be converted into an integer-based risk score. External validation will be required before wider use.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to develop a clinical prediction model for severe measles outcomes among hospitalized children during the 2026 outbreak in Bangladesh. The rationale was to address the need for a tool to identify children at risk of severe measles complications.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an internal validation of a clinical prediction model using routine hospital records from Chittagong Medical College Hospital for patients under 18 years admitted from March to October 2026. The population includes hospitalized children during the 2026 measles outbreak.
analysis.methods: A multivariable logistic regression model with 1,000 bootstrap samples will be used to develop and validate the prediction model. The model will incorporate demographic, clinical, vaccination, and nutritional factors as predictors.
analysis.main_results: The study will assess model discrimination and calibration to evaluate the performance of the clinical prediction model. If appropriate, the model will be converted into an integer-based risk score.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors will interpret the model's performance in terms of its ability to predict severe measles outcomes accurately. The novelty lies in the development of a risk score that can be used in clinical settings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform clinical decision-making by providing a tool to identify children at risk of severe measles outcomes. This may aid in targeted interventions and resource allocation during outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to internal validation, and external validation will be required before wider use. The evidence is based on routine hospital records, which may introduce biases or missing data.

analysis.summary_en: This study focuses on developing and internally validating a clinical prediction model for severe measles outcomes among hospitalized children during the 2026 outbreak in Bangladesh. The model will use demographic, clinical, vaccination, and nutritional factors as predictors. Severe outcomes include death, intensive care admission, mechanical ventilation, severe pneumonia requiring oxygen, or severe neurological complications. The authors will assess model discrimination and calibration, and if appropriate, convert the model into an integer-based risk score. The study's findings may inform clinical decision-making and resource allocation during measles outbreaks. However, the evidence is limited to internal validation, and external validation will be necessary for broader application.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to develop a clinical prediction model for severe measles outcomes among hospitalized children during the 2026 outbreak in Bangladesh. The rationale was to address the need for a tool to identify children at risk of severe measles complications.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study is an internal validation of a clinical prediction model using routine hospital records from Chittagong Medical College Hospital for patients under 18 years admitted from March to October 2026. The population includes hospitalized children during the 2026 measles outbreak.
elements_en.methods: A multivariable logistic regression model with 1,000 bootstrap samples will be used to develop and validate the prediction model. The model will incorporate demographic, clinical, vaccination, and nutritional factors as predictors.
elements_en.main_results: The study will assess model discrimination and calibration to evaluate the performance of the clinical prediction model. If appropriate, the model will be converted into an integer-based risk score.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors will interpret the model's performance in terms of its ability to predict severe measles outcomes accurately. The novelty lies in the development of a risk score that can be used in clinical settings.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform clinical decision-making by providing a tool to identify children at risk of severe measles outcomes. This may aid in targeted interventions and resource allocation during outbreaks.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to internal validation, and external validation will be required before wider use. The evidence is based on routine hospital records, which may introduce biases or missing data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发一个用于评估2026年孟加拉国暴发期间住院儿童严重麻疹结局的临床预测模型。其理由是应对识别严重麻疹并发症高风险儿童工具的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对一个临床预测模型的内部验证,使用奇塔格朗医学系医院的常规住院记录,用于2026年3月至10月期间年龄小于18岁的患者。研究人群包括2026年麻疹 暴发期间住院的儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 将使用包含1000个自举样本的多变量逻辑回归模型来开发和验证预测模型。该模型将纳入人口统计学、临床、疫苗接种和营养因素作为预测变量。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究将评估模型的区分度和校准度,以评价临床预测模型的性能。如果合适,该模型将被转换为基于整数的风险评分。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将根据模型预测严重麻疹结局的能力来解释其表现。创新之处在于开发了一个可在临床环境中使用的风险评分。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可通过提供一种识别严重麻疹结局高风险儿童的工具,从而指导临床决策。这可能有助于在暴发期间进行有针对性的干预和资源分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于内部验证,因此在广泛使用前需要进行外部验证。证据基于常规住院记录,这可能引入偏倚或缺失数据。

papers.title_zh: 2026年孟加拉国麻疹疫情期间住院儿童严重麻疹结局的临床预测模型的开发与内部验证
papers.source_body_en: This study will develop and internally validate a clinical prediction model for severe measles outcomes among hospitalized children during the 2026 outbreak in Bangladesh. Routine hospital records from Chittagong Medical College Hospital will be used for patients under 18 years admitted from March to October 2026. Demographic, clinical, vaccination, and nutritional factors will be assessed as predictors. Severe outcome will include death, intensive care admission, mechanical ventilation, severe pneumonia requiring oxygen, or severe neurological complications. A multivariable logistic regression model with 1,000 bootstrap samples will be used. Model discrimination and calibration will be assessed. If appropriate, the model will be converted into an integer-based risk score. External validation will be required before wider use.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究将开发并进行内部验证,以评估2026年孟加拉国暴发期间住院儿童严重麻疹结局的临床预测模型。将使用奇塔格朗医学系医院的常规住院记录,用于2026年3月至10月期间年龄小于18岁的患者。将评估人口统计学、临床、疫苗接种和营养因素作为预测变量。严重结局包括死亡、转入重症监护病房、机械通气、需要吸氧的严重肺炎或严重神经并发症。将使用包含1000个自举样本的多变量逻辑回归模型。将评估模型的区分度和校准度。如果合适,该模型将被转换为基于整数的风险评分。在广泛使用前需要进行外部验证。

papers.full_text: Almost 900 people in Bangladesh are suspected to have died in a measles outbreak that began in March. Most of those affected are children. Measles is one of the most infectious diseases known. It can spread rapidly when vaccination rates fall, and the Bangladesh outbreak shows how quickly years of gaps in protection can turn into a serious public health crisis. The country had hoped to eliminate measles and rubella by 2020. Instead, the pandemic disrupted routine childhood vaccinations, leaving pockets of children vulnerable to the virus. Now other countries where vaccination rates have fallen face a similar risk. Vaccine hesitancy is probably part of the story here too. During the COVID pandemic, almost half of Bangladesh’s population were wary of getting vaccinated. That same wariness may well have carried over to the measles-rubella jab, with many parents simply refusing to let their children be vaccinated. Measles has its own set of drivers, too. Poverty, education levels, and how often mothers attend antenatal check-ups all shape whether children in a community end up vaccinated. Add it all up, and childhood vaccination coverage has been sliding for years – down to just 87%. Between March 15 and September 6 2026, Bangladesh reported 92 suspected measles cases per 100,000 population and 11 confirmed measles cases per 100,000 population, based on an estimated national population of 178 million. In March 2026, Bangladesh’s vaccine advisory group approved an emergency measles-rubella vaccination campaign for children aged six months to five years, with extra provisions for infants aged six to eight months. Children normally get two doses of the measles vaccine. During this outbreak, however, the World Health Organization (WHO) advised giving one additional dose to all children in the target age group, regardless of whether they had been vaccinated before, to slow transmission and prevent severe illness. This built a rapid wall of immunity. The vaccination campaign began in early April in 30 sub‐districts across 18 priority districts, then rolled out nationwide later in the month. It was the first national measles campaign since 2020. In the intervening years, routine vaccination services were badly disrupted by the pandemic and political instability, leaving many children without full protection. Alongside vaccination, every child with suspected or confirmed measles was given vitamin A, a simple supportive treatment for active and suspected infections that lowers the risk of severe illness and death. A nationwide vitamin A drive had already taken place in 2025, and the advisory teams built on that experience for this 2026 outbreak. Bangladesh’s Directorate General of Health Services activated district rapid response teams, and hospitals added isolation beds and tightened infection control measures. Paediatric wards in some hospitals quickly filled with children with high fever, rash and breathing difficulties. Operational teams began producing weekly situation reports, and health authorities issued new national and divisional guidelines covering vaccination, patient care and vaccine supply. This helped local authorities across all eight administrative divisions to coordinate their response as the outbreak spread. Unicef, the WHO and Gavi (global vaccine alliance) worked with the government to back the response. Organisations such as Save the Children ran community awareness drives, including door-to-door visits and work with mothers’ groups and schools, to encourage families to register their children and bring them for vaccination. Even with this large‐scale national campaign, risks remain. If children miss their routine booster shots, or if large gatherings continue, or if rumours keep parents away from vaccination centres, another wave of infections is back knocking the door. Measles is highly contagious – one infected person can pass it on to dozens of others if the people around them aren’t protected. It travels through the air in a cough or a sneeze, and can hang there, invisible, long after the person who sneezed has left the room. That’s why vaccination can’t be patchy – it has to be active, widespread, and reach every corner of a community to break the chain of infection. Herd immunity The COVID pandemic introduced many people to the term “herd immunity” – the idea that once enough of a community is immune to a disease, it becomes hard for the infection to spread. For measles, that threshold is high: around 95% of a community needs to be vaccinated to keep the disease under control. Even a small dip in vaccination rates can leave pockets of unprotected children. A single imported case is then enough to spark an outbreak, and Bangladesh’s recent experience shows how those small pockets can grow over several years. Similar patterns have played out in other countries where coverage has slipped. Some countries have managed to eliminate measles and rubella altogether – a significant public health milestone. Cabo Verde, Mauritius and Seychelles were the first in sub-Saharan Africa to reach it. Zimbabwe faced a large measles outbreak in 2022. Intensive vaccination campaigns helped contain the virus, prevent hospitalisations and save lives. In 2016, the Americas became the first WHO region to stop measles spreading continuously on its own. That status didn’t last: Venezuela recorded cases in 2018, followed by Brazil in 2019. The region regained its elimination status in 2024, then lost it again in November 2025 after cases emerged in Canada. Elimination is a major achievement, but holding on to it depends on sustained routine vaccination, strong surveillance and the ability to respond quickly when outbreaks occur. Bangladesh’s outbreak is a reminder that vaccines only work if people actually receive them. The science has already done its job: measles vaccines are safe, effective, and have protected children for decades. What’s missing is trust, access, and the urgency needed to close the gap – until that changes, outbreaks like this one won’t be the last.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study highlights the risk of measles outbreaks in countries with declining vaccination rates, particularly in Bangladesh, where the pandemic and political instability disrupted routine immunization programs.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focuses on the measles outbreak in Bangladesh, which began in March 2026, and examines the impact of reduced vaccination rates on public health, particularly among children aged six months to five years.
analysis.methods: The study uses reported measles case data and vaccination coverage statistics to analyze the outbreak's progression and the factors contributing to the decline in immunization rates, including pandemic-related disruptions and community-level vaccine hesitancy.
analysis.main_results: Between March 15 and September 6 2026, Bangladesh reported 92 suspected measles cases per 100,000 population and 11 confirmed measles cases per 100,000 population. Vaccination coverage had dropped to 87%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that measles can spread rapidly when vaccination rates fall, and Bangladesh's outbreak demonstrates how gaps in immunization can lead to a serious public health crisis. This is a novel observation in the context of recent global trends in vaccine hesitancy and coverage decline.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for sustained vaccination efforts, strong surveillance systems, and community engagement to prevent future outbreaks, especially in regions with declining immunization rates.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on reported case numbers and vaccination coverage, which may be subject to underreporting or incomplete data. The study provides moderate confidence in its conclusions due to the reliance on observational data rather than controlled experiments.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the resurgence of measles in Bangladesh due to declining vaccination rates, which were exacerbated by the pandemic and political instability. The outbreak, which began in March 2026, resulted in suspected and confirmed cases, with coverage dropping to 87%. The authors emphasize that measles can spread rapidly in communities with low immunization rates, and Bangladesh's experience serves as a warning for other countries facing similar challenges. The study underscores the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage, robust surveillance, and community engagement to prevent future outbreaks. While the findings are based on observational data, they provide moderate confidence in the risks associated with vaccine hesitancy and the need for sustained public health efforts.

papers.full_text: AbstractBackground:Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a progressive, often fatal inflammatory encephalitis caused by persistent measles virus infection of the central nervous system. The neurological manifestations of SSPE are well characterised, encompassing cognitive decline, periodic myoclonic jerks, and often relentless progression.Case Report:We report a case of a 14-year-old male with SSPE who developed bilateral lower limb shaking and knee buckling, with associated loss of quadriceps tone on standing. These features resulted in recurrent falls and necessitated supported ambulation.Discussion:To our knowledge, this combination of orthostatic limb shaking and loss of tone in the context of SSPE has not been previously described in the literature. This case expands the recognised phenotypic spectrum of SSPE.Keywords: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis, SSPE, Orthostatic myoclonus, Orthostatic hyperkinetic disorders, Orthostatic Tremor DiscussionOrthostatic tremor is a distinct movement disorder characterised by a high-frequency (13 to 18 Hz) tremor of the legs and trunk upon standing, with symptomatic improvement on walking or sitting [3]. It has been associated with different etiologies, including Parkinson’s disease, dystonia, and other movement disorders [4,5,6,7]. Orthostatic negative myoclonus, by contrast, involves brief lapses of postural muscle tone, clinically manifesting as sudden knee buckling or “leg giving way” on standing. Both phenomena have been reported in various neurological contexts, including cortical and subcortical disease [8]. There are no reports of their co-occurrence in SSPE.There is evidence to support staging-dependent shift [9] in SSPE myoclonus subtype, with cortico-subcortical involvement in Jabbour II before progressing to brainstem-predominant myoclonus at later stages. This cortico-subcortical generator is consistent with a network capable of producing both standing-triggered oscillatory activity and inhibitory cortical lapses, selectively unmasked by postural loading. The cerebellar–SMA pathway implicated in primary OT may be rendered dysfunctional by SSPE’s predilection for subcortical white matter, producing conditions analogous to the double-lesion hypothesis in which concurrent cerebellar and basal ganglia disruption permits the orthostatic oscillator to become clinically manifest, a mechanism supported by the precedent of orthostatic leg tremor arising from mGluR5 autoimmune encephalitis [10].One case report documents orthostatic leg tremor as the initial manifestation in mGluR5 autoimmune encephalitis, suggesting that inflammatory CNS disease can generate orthostatic-specific motor phenomena [10].In this patient, the combination of orthostatic limb shaking and orthostatic negative myoclonus likely reflects disruption of the subcortical and cortical networks subserving postural tone regulation, consistent with the diffuse encephalitic process of SSPE. The selective involvement of the quadriceps during weight-bearing activities (both standing and walking), with preservation of sufficient motor function for supported ambulation and independence in ADL, suggests a functional threshold effect in which postural loading unmasks deficits that are not apparent at rest.The principal limitation of this case is the absence of surface or needle EMG, which is the gold standard for confirming a diagnosis of orthostatic tremor and characterizing the frequency and identifying the electromyographic silent periods pathognomonic of negative myoclonus. Thereby, we were not able to categorize the limb shaking as tremor because of the absence of electrophysiologic studies. Future cases should incorporate neurophysiological assessment to more precisely characterise these phenomena. ConclusionThis case expands the recognised phenotypic spectrum of SSPE to include orthostatic limb shaking and orthostatic negative myoclonus. Clinicians evaluating young patients with falls, particularly in the context of cognitive decline or in measles-endemic regions, should consider SSPE in the differential. Electrophysiological evaluation with EMG is recommended when feasible to confirm the diagnosis. IntroductionSSPE is a rare and often fatal neuro-inflammatory condition affecting predominantly children and adolescents, arising from persistent defective measles virus infection years after the initial exposure. The clinical course [1,2] follows a well-recognised progression: initial behavioural and intellectual deterioration, followed by myoclonic jerks, seizures, and eventual autonomic dysfunction and a vegetative state. While myoclonus is a hallmark of SSPE, the occurrence of orthostatic hyperkinetic movement phenomenology, namely orthostatic lower limb shaking and orthostatic negative myoclonus, represents an atypical and underreported manifestation. We present a case illustrating these phenomena and their functional consequences. Case PresentationA 14-year-old unvaccinated male, had developed measeles at the age of 7 years, with a self limiting course over two weeks and presented with a one-year history of falls and increasing difficulty with standing. His caregivers reported that he had experienced cognitive decline relative to his premorbid baseline, after a six year latent period following the initial measles infection; however, he retained the ability to obey simple commands and remained functionally independent in activities of daily living. He was ambulatory with physical support.On clinical assessment, the patient demonstrated shaking of the lower extremities that appeared exclusively on standing (Video 1) and resolved upon sitting, lying down, and walking. In addition, brief, sudden episodes of bilateral knee buckling were observed during the orthostatic position and persisted during walking, manifesting as transient knee flexion interrupting the gait cycle, characterised by loss of quadriceps tone without preceding tonic activity, consistent with negative myoclonus. These episodes were the principal cause of his recurrent falls. The orthostatic phenomena were reproducible on examination. Imaging showed bilateral frontal grey and white matter lesions with involvement of the genu of the corpus callosum (Figure 1). There were no brainstem lesions.Video 1The video demonstrates orthostatic lower limb shaking and orthostatic negative myoclonus in a 14-year-old male with SSPE. On standing, shaking is evident in both lower limbs, transmitted to the trunk and upper body. Superimposed on this, episodic bilateral knee buckling with giving way is observed, consistent with orthostatic negative myoclonus. On walking, the shaking resolves; however, periodic episodes of negative myoclonus persist, manifesting as brief interruptions of gait with transient knee flexion.Figure 1Brain MRI showing bilateral frontal grey and white matter lesions with involvement of the genu of the corpus callosum.MRI brain showing bilateral FLAIR hyperintensities of grey and white matter predominantly of the Frontal lobeHe had Jabbour Stage II symptoms and was confirmed to have SSPE based on an EEG showing periodic complexes, MRI with subcortical white matter involvement, and CSF measles index positivity. He was treated with intrathecal interferons and valproate. There was stabilization of his symptoms over a follow up of 6 months. Ethics and ConsentEthics Review: Ethics Committee approval was not required.Patient Consent: Written informed consent for publication was obtained from the patient.Ethical Publication Statement: We confirm that we have read the Journal’s position on issues involved in ethical publication and affirm that this work is consistent with those guidelines. analysis.research_question_and_background: This case expands the recognised phenotypic spectrum of SSPE.Keywords: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis, SSPE, Orthostatic myoclonus, Orthostatic hyperkinetic disorders, Orthostatic Tremor DiscussionOrthostatic tremor is a distinct movement disorder characterised by a high-frequency (13 to 18 Hz) tremor of the legs and trunk upon standing, with symptomatic improvement on walking or sitting [3].
analysis.study_design_and_population: The neurological manifestations of SSPE are well characterised, encompassing cognitive decline, periodic myoclonic jerks, and often relentless progression.Case Report:We report a case of a 14-year-old male with SSPE who developed bilateral lower limb shaking and knee buckling, with associated loss of quadriceps tone on standing.
analysis.methods: The cerebellar–SMA pathway implicated in primary OT may be rendered dysfunctional by SSPE’s predilection for subcortical white matter, producing conditions analogous to the double-lesion hypothesis in which concurrent cerebellar and basal ganglia disruption permits the orthostatic oscillator to become clinically manifest, a mechanism supported by the precedent of orthostatic leg tremor arising from mGluR5 autoimmune encephalitis [10].One case report documents orthostatic leg tremor as the initial manifestation in mGluR5 autoimmune encephalitis, suggesting that inflammatory CNS disease can generate orthostatic-specific motor phenomena [10].In this patient, the combination of orthostatic limb shaking and orthostatic negative myoclonus likely reflects disruption of the subcortical and cortical networks subserving postural tone regulation, consistent with the diffuse encephalitic process of SSPE.
analysis.main_results: He was ambulatory with physical support.On clinical assessment, the patient demonstrated shaking of the lower extremities that appeared exclusively on standing (Video 1) and resolved upon sitting, lying down, and walking.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该病例扩展了SSPE已知的表型谱系。关键词:亚急性硬化性全脑炎,SSPE,直立性肌阵挛,直立性超动障碍,直立性震颤 讨论直立性震颤是一种独特的运动障碍,其特征是在站立时腿部和躯干出现高频(13至18 Hz)震颤,而在行走或坐位时症状有所缓解 [3]。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: SSPE的神经学表现已被充分描述,包括认知功能下降、周期性肌阵挛抽搐以及通常不可逆的进展。病例报告:我们报告了一例14岁男性SSPE患者,其出现双下肢震颤和膝关节屈曲,伴有站立时股四头肌张力丧失。
elements_zh.methods: 在原发性OT中涉及小脑-运动皮层通路的可能功能障碍,可能是由于SSPE对皮层下白质的偏好性影响所致,从而产生类似于双病灶假说的状况,其中同时的小脑和基底节损伤允许直立性振荡器临床表现,这一机制得到了由mGluR5自身免疫性脑炎引起的直立性腿部震颤的先例支持 [10]。一项病例报告研究记录了直立性腿部震颤作为mGluR5自身免疫性脑炎的初始表现,表明炎症性中枢神经系统疾病可以产生直立性特异性运动现象 [10]。在该患者中,直立性肢体震颤与直立性负肌阵挛的组合很可能反映了对皮层下和皮层网络的破坏,这些网络负责姿势张力调节,与SSPE的广泛脑炎过程一致。
elements_zh.main_results: 患者在物理辅助下可行走。临床评估显示,该患者在站立时出现下肢震颤(视频1),而在坐位、躺位和行走时症状缓解。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 亚急性硬化性全脑炎中的半球性半肌阵挛——一项新观察。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在可行的情况下,建议通过肌电图(EMG)进行电生理评估以确认诊断。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 未发现脑干病变。视频1该视频展示了一例14岁男性SSPE患者在站立时出现的下肢震颤和直立性负肌阵挛。

papers.title: Trained Immunity in Childhood Vaccination.
papers.abstract: Conventionally, vaccine design has focused on identifying antigens that induce durable T and B cell memory and provide long term protection against subsequent encounters with the same pathogen. Unconventionally, a growing number of epidemiological, preclinical, and clinical studies demonstrate that live vaccines, including Bacillus Calmette Guérin (BCG), measles-containing vaccines, and oral polio vaccine, induce protection through trained immunity, a form of metabolically and epigenetically mediated memory in innate immune cells and their progenitors. This concept is particularly relevant during early life, when adaptive immune responses are constrained and innate immunity represents the principal line of host defence. In this review, we discuss the unique characteristics of neonatal and infant immunity, summarize current evidence for trained immunity induced by childhood vaccines, and describe the bidirectional interplay between innate and adaptive immune memory. We further highlight the potential of trained immunity to broaden protection against severe infections, improve vaccine efficacy, and provide therapeutic opportunities for non-infectious paediatric diseases, including cancer and allergic disorders. Harnessing trained immunity represents a conceptual shift in paediatric vaccinology and may guide the development of next generation vaccines that provide broader and more resilient protection during the period of greatest immunological vulnerability.

papers.title_original: Trained Immunity in Childhood Vaccination.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the concept of trained immunity in the context of childhood vaccination, specifically examining how vaccines like measles-containing vaccines induce protection through innate immune memory mechanisms. The central question is whether trained immunity can enhance vaccine efficacy and provide broader protection against severe infections and non-infectious paediatric diseases.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a conceptual analysis of existing literature, summarizing epidemiological, preclinical, and clinical studies that demonstrate the role of trained immunity in live vaccines such as measles-containing vaccines. It does not report on specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods, but it outlines the general approach of synthesizing findings from these studies.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that trained immunity, mediated by innate immune cells and their progenitors, plays a significant role in the protective effects of measles-containing vaccines. It highlights the bidirectional interplay between innate and adaptive immune memory, particularly relevant during early life when adaptive responses are limited.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges that while trained immunity is a promising area, there are unresolved questions about its mechanisms and the extent of its protective effects. It also notes that the evidence is still emerging and that more research is needed to fully understand its implications for vaccine design and paediatric health.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that understanding trained immunity could lead to the development of next-generation vaccines with broader and more resilient protection. It also emphasizes the potential therapeutic applications of trained immunity in non-infectious paediatric diseases such as cancer and allergic disorders.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the concept of trained immunity in childhood vaccination, particularly in the context of measles-containing vaccines. It highlights how these vaccines induce protection through innate immune memory, which is especially relevant during early life when adaptive immunity is limited. The review summarizes current evidence and discusses the potential of trained immunity to improve vaccine efficacy and offer therapeutic opportunities for non-infectious diseases. However, it also notes unresolved questions and the need for further research to clarify the mechanisms and applications of trained immunity in paediatric health.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于儿童疫苗背景下训练免疫的概念,特别是探讨含有麻疹的疫苗如何通过固有免疫记忆机制诱导保护。核心问题是训练免疫是否能够增强疫苗效力并提供对严重感染和非感染性儿科疾病的更广泛保护。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对现有文献的概念性分析,总结了流行病学、临床前和临床研究中显示训练免疫在活疫苗(如含有麻疹的疫苗)中作用的证据。它并未报告特定数据库、检索日期或元分析方法,而是概述了从这些研究中综合发现的一般方法。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,训练免疫通过固有免疫细胞及其前体介导,在含有麻疹的疫苗的保护作用中起着重要作用。它强调了固有免疫和适应性免疫记忆之间的双向相互作用,特别是在生命早期适应性反应有限的情况下尤为重要。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述承认,尽管训练免疫是一个有前景的领域,但其机制和保护范围仍存在未解决的问题。同时,它指出相关证据仍在发展中,需要更多研究来全面理解其对疫苗设计和儿科健康的影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议,理解训练免疫可能有助于开发下一代具有更广泛和更稳固保护的疫苗。它还强调了训练免疫在非感染性儿科疾病(如癌症和过敏性疾病)中的潜在治疗应用。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the concept of trained immunity in the context of childhood vaccination, specifically examining how vaccines like measles-containing vaccines induce protection through innate immune memory mechanisms. The central question is whether trained immunity can enhance vaccine efficacy and provide broader protection against severe infections and non-infectious paediatric diseases.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a conceptual analysis of existing literature, summarizing epidemiological, preclinical, and clinical studies that demonstrate the role of trained immunity in live vaccines such as measles-containing vaccines. It does not report on specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods, but it outlines the general approach of synthesizing findings from these studies.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that trained immunity, mediated by innate immune cells and their progenitors, plays a significant role in the protective effects of measles-containing vaccines. It highlights the bidirectional interplay between innate and adaptive immune memory, particularly relevant during early life when adaptive responses are limited.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges that while trained immunity is a promising area, there are unresolved questions about its mechanisms and the extent of its protective effects. It also notes that the evidence is still emerging and that more research is needed to fully understand its implications for vaccine design and paediatric health.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that understanding trained immunity could lead to the development of next-generation vaccines with broader and more resilient protection. It also emphasizes the potential therapeutic applications of trained immunity in non-infectious paediatric diseases such as cancer and allergic disorders.

papers.title_zh: 儿童时期训练免疫
papers.source_body_en: Conventionally, vaccine design has focused on identifying antigens that induce durable T and B cell memory and provide long term protection against subsequent encounters with the same pathogen. Unconventionally, a growing number of epidemiological, preclinical, and clinical studies demonstrate that live vaccines, including Bacillus Calmette Guérin (BCG), measles-containing vaccines, and oral polio vaccine, induce protection through trained immunity, a form of metabolically and epigenetically mediated memory in innate immune cells and their progenitors. This concept is particularly relevant during early life, when adaptive immune responses are constrained and innate immunity represents the principal line of host defence. In this review, we discuss the unique characteristics of neonatal and infant immunity, summarize current evidence for trained immunity induced by childhood vaccines, and describe the bidirectional interplay between innate and adaptive immune memory. We further highlight the potential of trained immunity to broaden protection against severe infections, improve vaccine efficacy, and provide therapeutic opportunities for non-infectious paediatric diseases, including cancer and allergic disorders. Harnessing trained immunity represents a conceptual shift in paediatric vaccinology and may guide the development of next generation vaccines that provide broader and more resilient protection during the period of greatest immunological vulnerability.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统上,疫苗设计的重点在于识别能够诱导持久T细胞和B细胞记忆并提供长期保护以应对相同病原体再次接触的抗原。然而,非传统地,越来越多的流行病学、临床前和临床研究显示,活疫苗,包括卡介苗(BCG)、含有麻疹的疫苗以及口服脊髓灰质炎疫苗,通过训练免疫提供保护,这是一种由代谢和表观遗传介导的固有免疫细胞及其前体的记忆形式。这一概念在生命早期尤为重要,因为适应性免疫在这一阶段受到限制,而固有免疫构成了主要的防御机制。在本综述中,我们将讨论新生儿和婴儿免疫的独特特征,总结目前关于儿童疫苗诱导训练免疫的证据,并描述固有免疫和适应性免疫记忆之间的双向相互作用。我们进一步强调了训练免疫在扩大对严重感染的保护范围、提高疫苗效力以及为非感染性儿科疾病(包括癌症和过敏性疾病)提供治疗机会方面的潜力。利用训练免疫代表了儿科疫苗学概念上的转变,可能指导下一代疫苗的开发,以在免疫系统最脆弱的时期提供更广泛和更稳固的保护。

papers.title: Dermatological Manifestations of Emergent Viruses. Part I: Common and Vaccine-Preventable Viral Infections.
papers.abstract: Viral infections frequently present with mucocutaneous manifestations that may provide diagnostic clues and guide timely management. However, the expanding therapeutic landscape and evolving public health recommendations highlight the need for an updated evidence-based review for dermatologists. Herein, we summarize the epidemiology, clinical presentation, diagnosis, management, and prevention of common and vaccine-preventable viral infections with dermatologic relevance, including Coronavirus Disease-2019 (COVID-19), mpox, measles, and rubella. Advances in antiviral therapies, immunomodulators, vaccination, and post-exposure prophylaxis have improved outcomes for several infections. Recognition of characteristic skin findings, familiarity with current diagnostic approaches, and implementation of evidence-based prevention strategies are essential for early diagnosis, appropriate treatment, and limiting disease transmission.
papers.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

papers.title: Evaluation of surveillance performance and determinants for priority vaccine-preventable diseases in Niger State, Nigeria: A CDC 2001 Guideline-based multilevel analysis
papers.abstract: Vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs) remain important causes of morbidity and mortality in sub-Saharan Africa, and evidence on subnational surveillance performance in Nigeria remains limited. We conducted a cross-sectional analytic evaluation of surveillance systems for measles, diphtheria, acute flaccid paralysis (AFP), and cerebrospinal meningitis (CSM) in Niger State, Nigeria. Data were collected from 415 clinicians, community resource persons, and surveillance focal persons across 12 purposively selected Local Government Areas using structured questionnaires adapted from CDC surveillance evaluation guidelines and aligned with IDSR guidance. Surveillance performance was assessed using sensitivity, data quality, and stability. Analyses included descriptive statistics, bivariate tests, and multivariable regression models. Reported suspected case detection was higher for measles and AFP than for CSM and diphtheria, with detection reported by 94.2% and 93.0% of respondents for measles and AFP, respectively, compared with 84.3% for CSM and 81.4% for diphtheria. Transport availability without delays was consistently associated with lower odds of surveillance failure across disease-specific models, including measles sample collection (aOR = 0.12, 95% CI: 0.05-0.28) and case confirmation (aOR = 0.07, 95% CI: 0.02-0.21), diphtheria sample collection (aOR = 0.18, 95% CI: 0.06-0.49) and confirmation (aOR = 0.22, 95% CI: 0.08-0.58), and CSM sample collection (aOR = 0.18, 95% CI: 0.06-0.54) and confirmation (aOR = 0.21, 95% CI: 0.07-0.61). Active guideline use was associated with AFP sample collection (aOR = 4.12, 95% CI: 1.72-9.87). Only 66.5% of respondents reported fully accurate submitted forms, and financial support was associated with lower odds of instability (aOR = 0.74, 95% CI: 0.56-0.97). Strengthening transport, infrastructure, financing, and data quality systems may improve VPD surveillance performance and outbreak preparedness in similar settings.

papers.title: Catching up in crisis: implementation of the big Catch-Up initiative in Yemen within a context of fragile routine immunization systems
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Decades of conflict in Yemen have decimated routine immunization infrastructure, produced a large population of zero-dose children, and precipitated recurring outbreaks of measles, diphtheria, pertussis, and polio. The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic further widened coverage gaps. This paper examines how pre-existing system fragility shaped the implementation and outcomes of the Big Catch-Up (BCU) initiative in southern Yemen. Methods A mixed-methods case study was conducted in southern Yemen in 2025. Data sources included administrative immunization records, key informant interviews ( n = 40), focus group discussions ( n = 12), a vaccinator survey ( n = 242), and observation of 40 vaccination sessions. Qualitative data were analyzed thematically; quantitative data were analyzed descriptively. Findings were triangulated across sources. Results By July 2025, national BCU administrative reach against nationally estimated antigen-specific targets was 7% for the first dose of pentavalent vaccine (Penta1), 3.7% for the third dose (Penta3), and 7.6% for the first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1), with children aged 24–59 months reached at consistently lower rates. Implementation was launched in September 2024 in southern Yemen amid system-level failures rooted in pre-existing fragility. The administrative reach in southern Yemen shows variations in vaccine-specific type and dose and geography. Updated tools and standard operating procedures arrived months after activities commenced; microplanning relied on a 2004 census that failed to account for mass displacement; demand-generation activities were underfunded; training was brief; and field supervision was consistently weak. Concurrent outbreak responses further strained the workforce. Distance, transport cost, restrictions on some women’s mobility, rumors, and fear of adverse events were also reported as barriers, particularly for older children. Insufficient attention to social and behavior change activities created additional barriers to uptake. Conclusions External financing and policy commitment may be insufficient for equitable catch-up vaccination when implementation depends on a fragile, conflict-affected health system – the same weaknesses that have long undermined routine immunization in the country. Time-bound campaigns cannot substitute for sustained primary health care investment, meaningful community engagement, improved population estimates, and financing models that extend beyond donor project cycles.
papers.journal: International Journal for Equity in Health

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the implementation of the Big Catch-Up (BCU) initiative in southern Yemen, focusing on measles virus-related challenges. The paper highlights how pre-existing system fragility, exacerbated by decades of conflict and the COVID-19 pandemic, hindered vaccine coverage. Administrative data show low reach for measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) and pentavalent vaccine (Penta1/Penta3), particularly among children aged 24–59 months. Mixed-methods analysis revealed systemic issues, including delayed tools, outdated census data, underfunded demand-generation, brief training, and weak supervision. Barriers such as distance, transport costs, mobility restrictions, rumors, and fear of adverse events were reported, especially for older children. The study concludes that external financing and policy commitment alone are insufficient for equitable catch-up vaccination in fragile health systems, emphasizing the need for sustained primary health care investment, community engagement, improved population estimates, and long-term financing models.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 麻疹病毒(Morbillivirus hominis),历史分类名称,麻疹和麻疹疾病。生物相关动物、分类、模型、差异诊断和比较实体仅作为补充,除非存在针对目标的实质性证据;只有明确的词汇或无关的硬性排除才是最终的。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 2025年在也门南部开展了一项混合方法案例研究。数据来源包括行政免疫记录、关键信息提供者访谈(n=40)、焦点小组讨论(n=12)、疫苗接种人员调查(n=242)以及对40个疫苗接种活动的观察。定性数据采用主题分析法,定量数据采用描述性分析法。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 截至2025年7月,全国BCU行动的行政覆盖率达到全国估计抗原特异性目标的7%(第一剂五联疫苗Penta1),3.7%(第三剂Penta3),以及7.6%(含麻疹病毒的第一次疫苗接种MCV1),其中24-59个月龄儿童的覆盖率为持续较低。研究结果通过多源交叉验证。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 更新的工具和标准操作程序在活动开始后数月才到达;微规划依赖于2004年的普查,未能考虑大规模人口流动;需求生成活动资金不足;培训时间短;现场监督始终薄弱。距离、交通成本、部分女性行动受限、谣言以及对不良事件的恐惧也被报告为障碍,尤其是对较大儿童而言。对社会和行为改变活动的关注不足,也造成了额外的接种障碍。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 时限性活动无法替代持续的初级卫生保健投资、有意义的社区参与、改进的人口估计以及超越捐助者项目周期的融资模式。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 也门数十年的冲突摧毁了常规免疫基础设施,导致大量零剂儿童,并引发了麻疹、白喉、百日咳和脊髓灰质炎的反复暴发。2019年冠状病毒病(COVID-19)大流行进一步扩大了覆盖率差距。本文探讨了在也门南部实施大追赶(BCU)行动时,原有系统脆弱性如何影响其实施和结果。方法 2025年在也门南部开展了一项混合方法案例研究。数据来源包括行政免疫记录、关键信息提供者访谈(n=40)、焦点小组讨论(n=12)、疫苗接种人员调查(n=242)以及对40个疫苗接种活动的观察。定性数据采用主题分析法,定量数据采用描述性分析法。研究结果通过多源交叉验证。结果 截至2025年7月,全国BCU行动的行政覆盖率达到全国估计抗原特异性目标的7%(第一剂五联疫苗Penta1),3.7%(第三剂Penta3),以及7.6%(含麻疹病毒的第一次疫苗接种MCV1),其中24-59个月龄儿童的覆盖率为持续较低。该行动于2024年9月在也门南部启动,当时系统层面的失败源于原有系统的脆弱性。也门南部的行政覆盖率在疫苗类型、剂量和地理区域上存在差异。更新的工具和标准操作程序在活动开始后数月才到达;微规划依赖于2004年的普查,未能考虑大规模人口流动;需求生成活动资金不足;培训时间短;现场监督始终薄弱。同时进行的麻疹应对措施进一步加剧了人力资源的紧张。距离、交通成本、部分女性行动受限、谣言以及对不良事件的恐惧也被报告为障碍,尤其是对较大儿童而言。对社会和行为改变活动的关注不足,也造成了额外的接种障碍。结论 当实施依赖于脆弱、受冲突影响的卫生系统时,外部资金和政策承诺可能不足以实现公平的麻疹追赶行动——这些弱点长期以来一直阻碍着该国的常规免疫工作。时限性活动无法替代持续的初级卫生保健投资、有意义的社区参与、改进的人口估计以及超越捐助者项目周期的融资模式。

papers.title: When health facilities close, outbreaks follow: the public health consequences of aid cuts in Somalia.
papers.abstract: Somalia's fragile health system is increasingly threatened by reductions in humanitarian financing, with potentially serious consequences for outbreak prevention and public-health preparedness. Recent funding cuts have already resulted in the closure of health and nutrition facilities and substantial reductions in service coverage, with further closures projected under severe funding scenarios. These disruptions extend beyond reduced access to curative care; they may interrupt routine immunization, nutrition screening and treatment, disease surveillance, referral pathways, and early outbreak detection. This is particularly concerning in Somalia, where recurrent measles, cholera, and diphtheria outbreaks occur amid persistent immunization gaps, displacement, conflict, and malnutrition. The 2025 diphtheria resurgence, alongside a substantial population of zero-dose children, demonstrates the risks associated with weak prevention systems. At the same time, the high burden of acute malnutrition increases vulnerability to infectious disease and places additional pressure on already constrained health services. Protecting health facilities should therefore be considered a core outbreak-prevention priority. Sustained financing for primary health care, routine immunization, nutrition, surveillance, and emergency preparedness is essential, particularly in underserved and high-risk communities. Strengthening domestic financing and contingency mechanisms will also be critical to maintaining essential services during future funding shocks and preventing avoidable deterioration in Somalia's public-health resilience.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为卫生服务中断(如设施关闭)显著增加对暴发的易感性的证据,强调了维持公共卫生韧性的持续资金支持的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现突显了保护卫生设施和确保初级卫生保健、免疫接种和监测持续资金的重要性,以防止暴发并改善索马里的公共卫生结果。

papers.title_zh: 当卫生设施关闭时,暴发随之而来:索马里人道主义资金削减对公共卫生的影响。
papers.source_body_en: Somalia's fragile health system is increasingly threatened by reductions in humanitarian financing, with potentially serious consequences for outbreak prevention and public-health preparedness. papers.abstract_zh: 索马里的脆弱卫生体系正日益受到人道主义资金削减的威胁,这可能对暴发预防和公共卫生准备产生严重后果。最近的资金削减已经导致卫生和营养设施的关闭以及服务覆盖率的大幅下降,在严重资金短缺的情况下,预计还会出现更多设施关闭。这些中断不仅限于减少对治疗服务的可及性;它们可能中断常规免疫接种、营养筛查和治疗,影响疾病监测,中断转诊途径,并阻碍早期暴发的检测。这在索马里尤其令人担忧,因为该国反复出现麻疹、霍乱和白喉暴发,同时存在持续的免疫接种缺口、人口流离失所、冲突和营养不良问题。2025年的白喉疫情回升,以及大量零剂儿童人口的存在,凸显了预防系统薄弱所带来的风险。同时,急性营养不良的高负担增加了对传染病的易感性,并给本已受限的卫生服务带来了额外压力。因此,保护卫生设施应被视为暴发预防的核心优先事项。持续的资金支持对于初级卫生保健、常规免疫接种、营养、监测以及应急准备至关重要,尤其是在未被充分服务和高风险社区中。加强国内资金和应急机制对于在未来资金冲击期间维持基本服务并防止索马里公共卫生韧性的不可挽回恶化也至关重要。

papers.title: Determinants of childhood vaccination differ between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions in Cameroon
papers.abstract: Introduction Childhood vaccination remains one of the most effective public health interventions, yet coverage is often lowest in settings affected by conflict and structural disadvantage. Cameroon has faced overlapping humanitarian crises in its Far North, North-West, and South-West regions, but evidence comparing determinants of full vaccination between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions remains limited. This study explores determinants of full vaccination status in 12–23 months children in Cameroon, stratified by conflict regions. Methods We conducted a secondary analysis of the 2018 Cameroon Demographic and Health Survey, including 1,824 living children aged 12–23 months. Full basic vaccination was defined as receipt of one dose of BCG, three doses of pentavalent vaccine, three doses of polio vaccine, and one dose of measles vaccine. Survey-weighted logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with full vaccination overall and by conflict status. Results Overall, 53.08% of children were fully vaccinated. Coverage was lower in conflict-affected than in non-conflict regions (45.29% versus 55.97%). In unadjusted analysis, conflict status was associated with lower odds of full vaccination, but this association was no longer significant in the adjusted model. At the national level, higher odds of full vaccination were associated with richer household wealth, maternal secondary or higher education, antenatal care attendance, and postnatal care. In conflict-affected regions, maternal secondary or higher education, postnatal care, and facility delivery remained significant predictors of full vaccination. Discussion Full vaccination coverage in Cameroon remains below desirable levels, with lower crude coverage in conflict-affected regions. However, after adjustment, conflict status was not independently associated with full vaccination, suggesting that socioeconomic conditions and contact with maternal health services are more important determinants. Strengthening antenatal and postnatal care and reducing socioeconomic barriers may improve vaccination coverage, especially in fragile settings.

analysis.scope_and_question: The study investigates determinants of full vaccination status in 12–23 months children in Cameroon, stratified by conflict regions. The focus is on measles virus and related entities, with the central question being how conflict status influences vaccination coverage.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a secondary analysis of the 2018 Cameroon Demographic and Health Survey, which included 1,824 living children aged 12–23 months. Survey-weighted logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with full vaccination overall and by conflict status.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Overall, 53.08% of children were fully vaccinated. Coverage was lower in conflict-affected regions (45.29%) compared to non-conflict regions (55.97%). However, after adjustment for socioeconomic and healthcare factors, conflict status was not independently associated with full vaccination, indicating that socioeconomic conditions and maternal health services are more significant predictors.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study notes that evidence comparing determinants of full vaccination between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions remains limited. Additionally, the association between conflict status and vaccination coverage was not significant in the adjusted model, suggesting potential confounding factors.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Strengthening antenatal and postnatal care and reducing socioeconomic barriers may improve vaccination coverage, especially in fragile settings. The findings highlight the importance of addressing structural disadvantages and improving access to maternal health services to enhance vaccination rates.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the determinants of childhood vaccination in Cameroon, focusing on measles virus and related entities. It finds that overall vaccination coverage is 53.08%, with lower rates in conflict-affected regions. However, after adjusting for socioeconomic and healthcare factors, conflict status alone is not a significant predictor of vaccination coverage. The research suggests that improving maternal health services and reducing socioeconomic barriers could enhance vaccination rates in conflict-affected areas. The study highlights the need for targeted interventions to address disparities in vaccination coverage, particularly in fragile settings.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究调查了喀麦隆12-23个月儿童疫苗接种完整接种状态的决定因素,并按冲突地区进行分层分析。研究重点是麻疹病毒及其相关实体,核心问题是冲突状态如何影响疫苗接种的覆盖率。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述基于2018年喀麦隆人口与健康调查的二次分析,该调查包括1,824名12-23个月的存活儿童。使用调查加权逻辑回归分析来识别与完整疫苗接种相关的因素,包括总体和按冲突状态分层的情况。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 总体而言,53.08%的儿童完成了完整接种。在冲突影响地区,接种覆盖率(45.29%)低于非冲突地区(55.97%)。然而,在调整了社会经济和医疗因素后,冲突状态与完整疫苗接种之间没有独立关联,表明社会经济状况和母亲健康服务是更为重要的预测因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本研究指出,比较冲突影响地区与非冲突地区儿童完整疫苗接种决定因素的证据仍然有限。此外,冲突状态与疫苗接种覆盖率之间的关联在调整模型中并不显著,这表明可能存在混杂因素。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 加强产前和产后护理,减少社会经济障碍,可能会提高疫苗接种的覆盖率,特别是在脆弱环境中。研究结果强调了应对结构性劣势和改善母亲健康服务获取的重要性,以提高疫苗接种接种率。

papers.abstract_zh: 引言 儿童疫苗接种仍然是最有效的公共卫生干预措施之一,但在冲突和结构性劣势影响的环境中,接种覆盖率往往最低。喀麦隆的远北、西北和西南地区经历了重叠的人道主义危机,但比较冲突影响地区与非冲突地区儿童疫苗接种决定因素的证据仍然有限。本研究探讨了喀麦隆12-23个月儿童疫苗接种完整接种状态的决定因素,并按冲突地区进行分层分析。方法 我们对2018年喀麦隆人口与健康调查进行了二次分析,包括1,824名12-23个月的存活儿童。完整基础疫苗接种被定义为接受一剂BCG疫苗、三剂五联疫苗疫苗、三剂脊髓灰质炎疫苗疫苗以及一剂麻疹 疫苗疫苗。使用调查加权逻辑回归分析来识别与完整疫苗接种相关的因素,包括总体和按冲突状态分层的情况。结果 总体而言,53.08%的儿童完成了完整接种。在冲突影响地区,接种覆盖率低于非冲突地区(45.29% vs 55.97%)。在未调整分析中,冲突状态与完整疫苗接种的较低可能性相关,但在调整模型中,这种关联不再显著。在国家层面,较高的家庭财富、母亲接受过中学或更高教育、产前检查和产后检查与完整疫苗接种的可能性较高相关。在冲突影响地区,母亲接受过中学或更高教育、产后检查和机构分娩仍然是完整疫苗接种的重要预测因素。讨论 喀麦隆的完整疫苗接种覆盖率仍低于理想水平,冲突影响地区的粗略覆盖率较低。然而,在调整了社会经济和医疗因素后,冲突状态与完整疫苗接种之间没有独立关联,这表明社会经济状况和母亲健康服务的接触更为重要。加强产前和产后护理,减少社会经济障碍,可能会提高疫苗接种的覆盖率,特别是在脆弱环境中。

papers.title: A Temporal Interactome Atlas across RNA Viruses reveals Convergent Vulnerabilities for Antiviral Repurposing
papers.abstract: Viruses remodel host protein interactions to facilitate their replication, yet these dynamic interactomes remain largely unmapped and difficult to compare across infections. Here, to facilitate comparative virology studies, we build the Interactome and Viral Infection Dynamics (InterVir) Atlas, performing thermal proximity coaggregation to profile temporal interactome remodeling across five major RNA viral pathogens. We develop PROTEA, an AI framework that quantifies interactome homology and identifies convergent regulatory hubs. Infection-specific signatures include neuronal SHC1 rewiring associated with altered measles virus replication and dengue-specific secretase interactomes linked to cell-junction remodeling. Comparative virology analyses uncover unexpected interactome convergence between measles and flaviviruses, unobserved in protein-abundance profiling. Mapping these shared regulatory programs to drug targets allowed prioritization of compound repurposing as antivirals. Experimental testing of ten compounds demonstrated antiviral efficacy across multiple infections. Together, InterVir and PROTEA establish an open-access resource for comparative virology, facilitating the identification of conserved host vulnerabilities and drug repurposing.

papers.source_body_en: Viruses remodel host protein interactions to facilitate their replication, yet these dynamic interactomes remain largely unmapped and difficult to compare across infections. papers.abstract_zh: 病毒通过重塑宿主蛋白互作来促进其复制,但这些动态互作组仍主要未被绘制且难以在不同感染间进行比较。在此,为了促进比较病毒学研究,我们构建了互作组与病毒感染动力学(InterVir)图谱,利用热邻近共聚集技术对五种主要的RNA病毒病原体进行时序互作组重塑的分析。我们开发了PROTEA,一个AI框架,用于量化互作组同源性并识别共同的调控枢纽。感染特异性特征包括与麻疹病毒复制改变相关的神经元SHC1重新布线以及与细胞连接重塑相关的登革热特异性分泌酶互作组。比较病毒学分析揭示了麻疹与黄病毒之间意想不到的互作组共同性,这在蛋白质丰度分析中未被观察到。将这些共享的调控程序映射到药物靶点上,使得抗病毒药物的化合物重新利用优先级得以确定。对十种化合物的实验测试表明抗病毒药物在多种感染中均有效。综上,InterVir和PROTEA共同建立了一个开放获取的比较病毒学资源,有助于识别保守的宿主脆弱性并实现药物重新利用。

papers.title: Pathways to health resilience: A cross-country analysis of health system response to re-emerging infectious diseases in Sub-Saharan Africa.
papers.abstract: Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) faces recurrent threats from re-emerging infectious diseases, including Ebola virus disease, cholera, measles, Lassa fever, and Marburg virus disease. This study assessed the resilience of health systems in 25 SSA countries from 2000 to 2023 using a multidimensional resilience index and a first-order Markov state-transition framework. Country-year observations were classified as Low Resilience, Moderate Resilience, or High Resilience based on epidemiological performance, health financing, surveillance, response capacity, and recovery indicators. Resilience was heterogeneous and path-dependent. Low-Resilience observations had an 82.4% probability of remaining in that state in the subsequent year and only a 3.1% probability of moving directly to High Resilience. Moderate-Resilience observations had a 19.1% probability of transitioning to High Resilience and an 18.2% probability of declining to Low Resilience. High-Resilience observations had a 63.6% probability of remaining High Resilience, but a combined 36.4% probability of regression. Multinomial logistic regression showed that health expenditure per capita, domestic health-financing share, and GDP per capita were positively associated with High Resilience, whereas internal armed conflict was negatively associated with High Resilience. Southern and Eastern Africa showed stronger resilience profiles than Western and Central Africa, while Central Africa had the greatest concentration of Low-Resilience countries. These findings indicate that resilience is dynamic, unevenly distributed, and strongly shaped by sustained financing, economic capacity, and political stability. Policy priorities include strengthening domestic health financing, targeting Moderate-Resilience countries for accelerated improvement, supporting conflict-affected systems, and harmonising regional surveillance and emergency-response mechanisms.
